definition_zh: n. 水牛；（北美）野牛
definition_en: a large wild ox of Africa or Asia; in North America, the bison, often called a buffalo
core_image: 一群野牛慢慢移过草原，身后浮起尘土
scene: 远处一群野牛慢慢移过草原，身后浮起尘土。 A herd of buffalo moved slowly across the plain, dust rising behind them.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：buffalo 指水牛或北美野牛；句意是远处一群野牛慢慢移过草原，身后尘土浮起。

senses.title: The wild ox of Africa and Asia
senses.definition: a large wild ox with heavy horns, including the water buffalo of Asia
senses.definitionCN: 有粗角的巨大野牛，包括亚洲水牛
senses.example: Water buffalo worked the rice fields.
senses.exampleCN: 水牛在稻田里干活。
senses.why: Buffalo first named the Asian and African animal.
senses.whyCN: buffalo 最初指亚洲与非洲的这种动物。

senses.title: The North American bison
senses.definition: the large shaggy bison of the North American plains, loosely called buffalo
senses.definitionCN: 北美平原上毛茸茸的大型野牛，俗称 buffalo
senses.example: Herds of buffalo once crossed the plains.
senses.exampleCN: 成群的野牛曾穿越平原。
senses.why: Settlers used the old word for a new animal.
senses.whyCN: 移民把这个旧词用在了新动物身上。

intro.en: Buffalo comes through Portuguese and Italian from Greek bous, an ox.
intro.cn: buffalo 经葡萄牙语与意大利语来自希腊语 bous（牛）。

items.en: Bous means an ox or a cow.
items.cn: bous 意为公牛或母牛。

items.en: Bubalus names a wild ox.
items.cn: bubalus 指野牛。

items.en: Bufalo carries the word into trade routes.
items.cn: bufalo 让该词进入贸易路线。

items.en: English buffalo names the Asian water buffalo.
items.cn: 英语 buffalo 指亚洲水牛。

items.en: Settlers apply it to the bison.
items.cn: 移民把它用于北美野牛。

items.en: American buffalo usually means bison.
items.cn: 美式英语中 buffalo 通常指北美野牛。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the buff- start; the near-meaning group gathers large cattle by continent.
note.cn: 形近组共享 buff- 开头；近义组按地域汇集大型牛类。

entries.definition: A strong yellowish colour, or to polish.
entries.definitionCN: 黄褐色；擦亮。

entries.definition: Something that reduces a shock.
entries.definitionCN: 减缓冲击之物。

entries.definition: A ridiculous person.
entries.definitionCN: 滑稽可笑的人。

entries.definition: To confuse completely.
entries.definitionCN: 使完全困惑。

entries.definition: A large shaggy wild ox of North America.
entries.definitionCN: 北美的大型长毛野牛。

entries.definition: A large domestic bovine used for work.
entries.definitionCN: 用于劳作的大型家牛。

entries.definition: A long-haired ox of the Himalayas.
entries.definitionCN: 喜马拉雅的长毛牛。

entries.definition: Large farm animals kept for meat or milk.
entries.definitionCN: 为肉或奶饲养的大型家畜。

normalIntro.en: Buffalo is an old word for a wild ox, later lent to the American bison.
normalIntro.cn: buffalo 是「野牛」的古词，后来借给了北美野牛。

normal.en: Two f and one l.
normal.cn: 两个 f、一个 l。

normal.en: It comes from Greek bous, an ox.
normal.cn: 它来自希腊语 bous（牛）。

normal.en: Water buffalo are the Asian kind.
normal.cn: water buffalo 是亚洲的那种。

normal.en: American buffalo are really bison.
normal.cn: 美国 buffalo 其实是 bison。

normal.en: The plural can stay buffalo.
normal.cn: 复数可以仍写作 buffalo。

abstract.en: Heavy bodies moving at their own speed.
abstract.cn: 按自己速度移动的沉重身躯。

abstract.en: Dust behind a whole herd.
abstract.cn: 一整群身后的尘土。

abstract.en: An old word given to a new continent.
abstract.cn: 一个旧词被交给了一片新大陆。

examples.en: Water buffalo stood knee-deep in the mud.
examples.cn: 水牛站在齐膝深的泥里。

examples.en: Buffalo once moved across the plains in millions.
examples.cn: 野牛曾以数百万之众穿越平原。

examples.en: The park protects a small herd of buffalo.
examples.cn: 公园保护着一小群野牛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「巴弗洛」——大块头慢慢走，谁也别催。

root: 希腊语 bous（牛）→ 拉丁语 bubalus（野牛）

sensesIntro.en: Buffalo is a word that travelled: from Greek ox to Asian water buffalo to the American plains.
sensesIntro.cn: buffalo 是个走得很远的词：从希腊语的牛，到亚洲水牛，再到北美平原。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a herd crossing a plain with dust rising behind
core.cn: 核心意象：一群野牛穿过平原，身后尘土升起

branches.en: Water buffalo in a rice field.
branches.cn: 稻田里的水牛。

branches.en: An ox standing in mud.
branches.cn: 站在泥里的牛。

branches.en: Bison crossing the plains.
branches.cn: 穿越平原的野牛。

branches.en: A hide stretched to dry.
branches.cn: 摊开晾干的野牛皮。

branches.en: One old word for two continents.
branches.cn: 一个旧词，两个大陆。

intro.en: Buffalo is a borrowed animal name; the list below covers it and the vocabulary of cattle.
intro.cn: buffalo 是借入的动物名；下面列出它以及「牛类」词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Greek bous is an ox, and Latin bos is a cow or ox.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 bous 意为牛，拉丁语 bos 意为牛。

definition_zh: n. 风笛（用臂下气囊供气、带低音管的簧管乐器，常用复数）；风笛声；风笛乐曲
definition_en: a wind instrument in which air pressed from a bag under the arm sounds reed pipes, usually used in the plural; the sound or music of this instrument
core_image: 臂下夹着鼓鼓的气囊、肩上斜插三根低音管的那副乐器
scene: 婚礼上新娘进场时，山坡上响起了风笛。 On the hillside the bagpipes sounded as the bride walked in.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：这里 bagpipes 指风笛发出的声音，而不是乐器本身；句意是新娘进场时山坡上传来笛声。

forms.label: 复数（英语中通常以复数出现）

derivatives.zh: （风笛的）低音持续管；持续低音

senses.title: The instrument itself
senses.definition: a musical instrument whose reed pipes are sounded by air squeezed from a bag held under the arm
senses.definitionCN: 一种簧管乐器，靠挤压夹在臂下的气囊供气发声
senses.example: He carried a set of bagpipes wrapped in green cloth.
senses.exampleCN: 他抱着一副用绿布包好的风笛。
senses.why: The name is literally bag plus pipe, so it describes how the instrument is fed with air rather than how it looks.
senses.whyCN: 这个词字面就是「袋」加「管」，因此描述的是供气方式，而不是外形。

senses.title: The sound it makes
senses.definition: the loud reedy sound of the instrument, or a tune played on it
senses.definitionCN: 这件乐器响亮带簧质的声音，或用它吹出的曲子
senses.example: The bagpipes drifted across the water before the boats came in.
senses.exampleCN: 船还没进港，风笛声先掠过水面传了过来。
senses.why: English lets an instrument name stand for its sound, so the plural can mean the music rather than the object.
senses.whyCN: 英语允许乐器名代指其声音，所以复数形式可以指乐声而非实物。

intro.en: Bagpipe is a plain English compound: bag plus pipe. The instrument is ancient, but the English name is a medieval description of how it is blown.
intro.cn: bagpipe 是一个朴素的英语复合词：bag「袋」加 pipe「管」。乐器本身很古老，但这个英语名字是中世纪对吹奏方式的直白描述。

items.en: Herders in the Near East already blew reed pipes fed by an animal-skin air bag.
items.cn: 近东的牧人早已用兽皮气囊供气吹响簧管。

items.en: Roman writers describe a pipe played with a bag, the tibia utricularis.
items.cn: 罗马作家记载过一种用气囊吹奏的管乐器 tibia utricularis。

items.en: Old English pipe meant a tube or a musical pipe, from Latin pipare, to chirp.
items.cn: 古英语 pipe 指管子或管乐器，源自拉丁语 pipare「啾鸣」。

items.en: Middle English joins bagge and pipe into baggepipe, the bag-blown pipe.
items.cn: 中古英语把 bagge「袋」与 pipe「管」合成 baggepipe，即用袋吹的管。

items.en: Scottish players fix the form with a chanter and drones, and the Highland pipe becomes a national emblem.
items.cn: 苏格兰乐手确立了指孔管加低音管的形制，高地风笛成为民族象征。

items.en: Army pipe bands carry the word worldwide, and the plural bagpipes becomes the usual form.
items.cn: 军中风笛队把这个词带到世界各地，复数 bagpipes 成为常用形式。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps other bag- and pipe- words so the compound stays visible; the near-meaning group names the parts of the instrument and its reed relatives.
note.cn: 形近组保留其他带 bag- 与 pipe- 的词，让这个复合结构一直看得见；近义组列出这件乐器的构件及其簧管亲属。

entries.definition: A row of tubes of different lengths.
entries.definitionCN: 一排长短不同的管子组成的乐器。

entries.definition: A long line carrying oil or gas.
entries.definitionCN: 输送石油或天然气的长管道。

entries.definition: Cases and bags taken on a journey.
entries.definitionCN: 旅行时带的箱包。

entries.definition: A long thin loaf of French bread.
entries.definitionCN: 细长的法式面包。

entries.definition: The pipe on which the tune is fingered.
entries.definitionCN: 用来按出旋律的那根管。

entries.definition: A pipe giving one unchanging low note.
entries.definitionCN: 发出恒定低音的管。

entries.definition: An old wind instrument and the dance for it.
entries.definitionCN: 一种古老管乐器，也指配它的舞蹈。

entries.definition: An orchestral double-reed woodwind.
entries.definitionCN: 管弦乐队中的双簧木管乐器。

normalIntro.en: Bagpipe is bag plus pipe: a bag of air feeding a set of pipes. Hold that picture and the word never needs memorising.
normalIntro.cn: bagpipe 就是 bag「袋」加 pipe「管」：一袋空气喂养一组管子。记住这幅画面，这个词就不必硬背。

normal.en: Picture a leather bag squeezed under one arm.
normal.cn: 想象一只皮囊夹在一条臂下被挤压。

normal.en: Three long pipes stick up over the shoulder.
normal.cn: 三根长管斜插在肩头上方。

normal.en: One short pipe takes the melody under the fingers.
normal.cn: 一根短管在指下奏出旋律。

normal.en: The bag keeps the sound going while the player breathes.
normal.cn: 吹奏者换气时，气囊让声音不断。

normal.en: Bag plus pipe equals bagpipe, and the plural is bagpipes.
normal.cn: bag 加 pipe 就是 bagpipe，复数是 bagpipes。

abstract.en: A stored breath that outlasts a single lungful.
abstract.cn: 一份存起来的气息，比一口气更长久。

abstract.en: One steady note under a moving tune.
abstract.cn: 流动的曲调之下垫着一个不动的音。

abstract.en: A whole country carried in a cloth bag.
abstract.cn: 一个民族被装进一只布袋里带走。

examples.en: The bagpipes struck up as the coffin left the church.
examples.cn: 棺木离开教堂时，风笛奏了起来。

examples.en: She learned the bagpipes at twelve and never put them down.
examples.cn: 她十二岁学风笛，此后一直没放下。

examples.en: A lone piper stood on the rock above the bay.
examples.cn: 一名风笛手独自站在海湾上方的岩石上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 拆件记忆：bag「袋子」+ pipe「管子」——臂下夹着一袋气去吹一组管子，就是 bagpipe 风笛；因为管子不止一根，英语里常说 bagpipes。

root: 英语 bag「袋」与 pipe「管」直接复合；pipe 上溯拉丁语 pipare「啾鸣」。乐器本身源自古代近东的兽皮气囊簧管，中古英语约 1400 年造出 baggepipe 这个名字，苏格兰高地确立形制后随军乐队传遍世界。

sensesIntro.en: Two senses, one object: the instrument you carry, and the sound that carries across a valley.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项，同一件东西：你抱着走的乐器，以及能越过整条山谷的声音。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a full air bag under one arm with long pipes over the shoulder
core.cn: 核心意象：一臂之下夹着饱满气囊，长管斜插肩头

branches.en: A cloth-wrapped set on the knee.
branches.cn: 膝上放着一副布包的乐器。

branches.en: Fingers working the short melody pipe.
branches.cn: 手指在短旋律管上按动。

branches.en: A thin cry across the water.
branches.cn: 掠过水面的一声细长鸣响。

branches.en: A slow lament at a graveside.
branches.cn: 墓边一支缓慢的哀曲。

branches.en: The bag that keeps both going.
branches.cn: 让实物与声音都不断的那只气囊。

intro.en: Bagpipe is built from two whole English words, so its parts are roots rather than prefixes; the endings below show how the family grows around it.
intro.cn: bagpipe 由两个完整的英语词构成，因此其构件是词根而非前缀；下面这些词尾展示这个词族如何扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer sits behind pipe: pipare, to chirp, and the Roman bag-fed pipe called tibia utricularis.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语层次藏在 pipe 之后：pipare「啾鸣」，以及罗马那种以囊供气的管乐器 tibia utricularis。

latinEntries.exampleCN: tibia 指罗马的一种管乐器。

definition_zh: 使相等；等同看待；折合
definition_en: to consider two things as the same, or to make amounts equal or interchangeable
core_image: 两架天平被人为放上同样的砝码，一根线把两个原本不同的词钉在同一格上
scene: 报表把工时直接折成成本。 Reports equate hours with cost.
sceneCN: 这里 equate 是「等同看待；使相等」（第 1 个义项：把两者摆成等价）；句意：报表把工时与成本等同。

collocations.zh: 把 A 与 B 等同

senses.title: To treat two things as one in value
senses.definition: to regard different notions as if they carried the same meaning or worth
senses.definitionCN: 把不同观念视作含义或价值相同
senses.example: Polls equate attention with support.
senses.exampleCN: 民调把关注度等同于支持度。
senses.why: The Latin stem is levelness itself, so the verb lays two things on one scale.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词干本义即平坦均等，动词因而把两物放上同一杆秤。

senses.title: To make amounts numerically equal
senses.definition: to set values equal, or to convert one into the other at a fixed rate
senses.definitionCN: 把数值设为相等，或按固定比率把一种换算成另一种
senses.example: The table equates units across currencies.
senses.exampleCN: 该表按不同货币折算单位。
senses.why: Accounting and science took the word for the arithmetic operation itself.
senses.whyCN: 会计与科学把该词用作算术运算本身。

senses.title: To match by comparison
senses.definition: a use in which one thing is held alongside another as its counterpart
senses.definitionCN: 把一物与另一物并置，视为与之相当的对应者
senses.example: Commentators equated the runner's grit.
senses.exampleCN: 评论者把跑者的韧劲拿来比配他人。
senses.why: Rhetoric borrows the equalising move to draw likeness between unlike things.
senses.whyCN: 修辞借这种拉平之举在异类之间描出相似。

intro.en: Equate is a modern verb drawn back from equation, whose Latin source aequatus means made level.
intro.cn: equate 是从 equation 逆推而来的晚近动词，其拉丁源头 aequatus 意为被弄平。

items.en: Aequus means level or fair.
items.cn: aequus 意为平坦、公正。

items.en: Aequare means to make level.
items.cn: aequare 意为使平坦。

items.en: Aequatus, made equal, feeds the noun equation.
items.cn: aequatus（被弄平）滋养了名词 equation。

items.en: English keeps equation before making a verb of it.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语先有 equation，再由此造出动词。

items.en: Equate appears in mathematical and commercial prose.
items.cn: 十九世纪 equate 见于数学与商务文本。

items.en: Social commentary adopts it for dubious identifications.
items.cn: 二十世纪社会评论用它指可疑的画等号。

note.en: Group one holds the aequus family; group two holds other verbs of making or claiming sameness.
note.cn: 第一组是 aequus 词族；第二组是其他表建立或声称同一性的动词。

entries.definition: The statement of equality, and the abstract act of equating.
entries.definitionCN: 等式，以及等同之举的抽象名词。

entries.definition: To bring things to the same level or score.
entries.definitionCN: 使达到同一水平或比分。

entries.definition: To speak on both sides of a question, evading a clear answer.
entries.definitionCN: 两可其辞，回避明确回答。

entries.definition: Level with what a task requires, from ad- plus aequus.
entries.definitionCN: 与任务所需持平，出自 ad- 加 aequus。

entries.definition: To treat one thing as the same as another.
entries.definitionCN: 把一物当作与另一物相同。

entries.definition: To set side by side as comparable.
entries.definitionCN: 并置以显可比。

entries.definition: To hold quantities in equilibrium.
entries.definitionCN: 使数量保持均势。

entries.definition: To correspond or pair as equal in kind.
entries.definitionCN: 相配或在同类中等量齐观。

normalIntro.en: Equate with or to is usual; equate as is the older bookish pattern.
normalIntro.cn: 常用 equate with 或 equate to，equate as 是较早的书面格式。

normal.en: In argument it warns of a false equivalence.
normal.cn: 在论辩中它警示错误的画等号。

normal.en: In finance it converts one unit into another.
normal.cn: 在财经中它把一种单位折算成另一种。

normal.en: Passive is common: salaries were equated with effort.
normal.cn: 被动式常见：薪水曾被视为与努力相等。

normal.en: Avoid it where analogy, not equality, is meant.
normal.cn: 本意是类比而非等同时不要用。

normal.en: Its noun is equation, not equatement.
normal.cn: 其名词为 equation，而非 equatement。

abstract.en: Picture a scale made honest only by adding weights.
abstract.cn: 想象一架只有加码才见公平的天平。

abstract.en: Imagine two coins stamped from one die.
abstract.cn: 想象两枚由同一印模压出的硬币。

abstract.en: Think of a spreadsheet cell that forces two columns to agree.
abstract.cn: 想想电子表格里迫使两列一致的那个单元格。

examples.en: Do not equate silence with consent.
examples.cn: 不要把沉默等同于同意。

examples.en: The schedule equates a night shift with extra pay.
examples.cn: 排班表把夜班折成额外工资。

examples.en: Historians equated the coin with a trade route.
examples.cn: 史家把这枚硬币与一条商路挂起等号。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一快他特」——一样快的两件东西被特意指成一类，所以 equate 是使相等、等同看待；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 aequus（平坦、均等）→ aequare（使平）→ aequatus（被弄平）→ 名词 equation → 逆构动词 equate，核心义「把两样东西放到同一水平线上」。

sensesIntro.en: The verb covers a claim of sameness, an arithmetic conversion, and a rhetorical pairing.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词涵盖同一性的断言、算术的折算与修辞的并置。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two uneven things brought to one line on the same scale.
core.cn: 核心意象：两样不齐之物被放上同一杆秤的同一条线。

branches.en: Judgment declares unlike things alike.
branches.cn: 判断把不同类之物宣称为同类。

branches.en: Arithmetic carries the claim into numbers.
branches.cn: 算术把这一宣称带进数字。

branches.en: Rhetoric pairs things for effect, not for proof.
branches.cn: 修辞为一效果而非一论证而并置两物。

branches.en: Both rest on comparison rather than measurement.
branches.cn: 两者都依赖比较而非计量。

branches.en: Both invite the charge of a false equivalence.
branches.cn: 两者都会招来虚假等号之责。

intro.en: A level adjective becomes a causative verb and then, in English, a back-formed verb with a fresh ending.
intro.cn: 表平坦的形容词先变为使动动词，再在英语里被逆构为带新词尾的动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin aequus is level, aequare to level, and aequatio a making equal.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 aequus 表平坦，aequare 表弄平，aequatio 表使相等。

items.example: The first vowel dropped in English.
items.exampleCN: 首音节元音在英语中脱落。

items.meaning: the act of pairing as equal

items.example: The noun precedes the verb historically.
A legal cousin on the same stem.
items.exampleCN: 同词干上的法律用语表亲。

items.example: The line that levels the globe.

definition_zh: n. 复印机；复制者，抄袭者
definition_en: a machine that copies documents, or a person who copies
core_image: 复印机的出纸口吐出一页页一模一样的纸
scene: 复印机卡了纸，办公室门口排起了队。 The copier jammed, and a queue formed in the office.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：copier 指复印机；句意是复印机卡纸让办公室排起队。

senses.title: A copying machine

definition_zh: 环境政策；政府或组织为保护环境、管理自然资源而制定的方针、法规与目标
definition_en: a set of official rules, targets and instruments that govern how people use and protect the natural environment
core_image: 一张被红笔圈满的地图，圈内是湿地、烟囱与输油管，旁边并列着许可与禁令
scene: 市政厅把排放上限、湿地保护线与垃圾回收目标写进同一份文件，这份环境政策将约束未来十年的建设。 The city hall wrote emission caps, wetland protection lines and recycling targets into one document, an environmental policy that would bind construction for the next ten years.
sceneCN: 这里 environmental policy 指「政府就环境利用与保护设定的成文方针与约束」（第 1 个义项：官方环境方针与法规集合）；句意为市政厅把排放上限、湿地保护线与回收目标写进同一份文件，这份环境政策将约束未来十年的建设。可辨识物件：圈注地图、排放上限表、许可印章、禁令标牌。

pos.zh: 环境政策（可数指一套政策，不可数指该领域）

senses.title: A government package of environmental rules
senses.definition: the combined laws, targets and instruments by which a government steers behaviour toward environmental goals
senses.definitionCN: 政府借以引导行为朝向环境目标的法律、目标与手段之总和
senses.example: The new environmental policy pairs a carbon cap with a wetland protection fund.
senses.exampleCN: 新的环境政策把碳排放上限与湿地保护基金配在一起。
senses.why: policy names a chosen course rather than a single law, so the phrase covers a package rather than one statute.
senses.whyCN: policy 指选定的路线而非单条法律，因此这个短语覆盖的是一整套安排，而不是一条法规。

senses.title: The instruments that carry it out
senses.definition: the permits, standards, taxes and subsidies through which the stated goals are enforced
senses.definitionCN: 用以执行既定目标的许可证、标准、税费与补贴
senses.example: Environmental policy works through discharge permits more often than through bans.
senses.exampleCN: 环境政策更多通过排污许可、而非禁令来起作用。
senses.why: once the course is chosen, the phrase shifts from goals to the tools that make the goals bite.
senses.whyCN: 路线一旦选定，这个短语就从目标转向让目标真正生效的工具。

senses.title: A cross-border agreement
senses.definition: coordinated commitments among states on shared problems such as air, rivers or climate
senses.definitionCN: 各国就空气、河流或气候等共同问题作出的协调承诺
senses.example: The river basin's environmental policy is set by a commission of four states.
senses.exampleCN: 该流域的环境政策由一个四国委员会制定。
senses.why: many environmental problems cross borders, so the phrase is used for agreements no single state can enforce alone.
senses.whyCN: 许多环境问题跨越国界，因此该短语也用于任何单一国家都无法独自执行的协定。

senses.title: A company's environmental code
senses.definition: a firm's stated commitments and internal rules on emissions, waste and sourcing
senses.definitionCN: 企业在排放、废弃物与采购方面公开承诺与内部规则
senses.example: The supplier audit checks whether the factory follows its own environmental policy.
senses.exampleCN: 供应商审核检查工厂是否遵守自家环境方针。
senses.why: the word policy also means an organisation's chosen line of action, so companies borrow the phrase for voluntary codes.
senses.whyCN: policy 也指组织选定的行动路线，因此企业用这个短语指自愿性守则。

senses.title: Local land-use and planning policy
senses.titleCN: 地方土地利用与规划政策
senses.definition: municipal rules on zoning, green space and transport that shape the local environment
senses.definitionCN: 影响本地环境的分区、绿地与交通方面的市政规则
senses.example: The town's environmental policy keeps the floodplain free of new housing.
senses.exampleCN: 该镇的环境政策使泛滥平原不再新建住宅。
senses.why: much environmental policy is delivered through planning decisions, so the phrase often appears in local documents.
senses.whyCN: 许多环境政策通过规划决策落地，因此该短语常出现在地方文件中。

senses.title: Conservation and protected-area policy
senses.definition: rules on parks, reserves and species protection that set aside land from development
senses.definitionCN: 关于公园、保护区与物种保护的规则，使土地不作开发之用
senses.example: Wildlife corridors became a central item of the province's environmental policy.
senses.exampleCN: 野生动物廊道成为该省环境政策的核心条目。
senses.why: the oldest strand of the phrase is direct protection: some land is simply withdrawn from use.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语最古老的一支是直接保护：把某些土地从用途中撤出。

senses.title: A field of study and analysis
senses.titleCN: 作为研究与分析领域的环境政策
senses.definition: the academic subject that compares how governments design and evaluate environmental rules
senses.definitionCN: 比较各国政府如何设计与评估环境规则的学术领域
senses.example: She teaches environmental policy and runs a clinic for local councils.
senses.exampleCN: 她教授环境政策，并为地方议会开设咨询工作坊。
senses.why: as a discipline, the phrase no longer names a decision but the study of how decisions are made.
senses.whyCN: 作为学科，这个短语不再指某项决定，而指对决定形成过程的研究。

senses.title: Abstract: an organisation's stance toward nature
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：一个机构对自然的态度
senses.definition: any declared attitude or priority an institution takes toward the natural world
senses.definitionCN: 任何机构对自然界公开表明的态度或优先次序
senses.example: The museum's environmental policy was simply to stop printing guides.
senses.exampleCN: 这家博物馆的环境方针简单到只是停止印刷导览册。
senses.why: the abstract use keeps only the notion of a declared line, with no legal force behind it.
senses.whyCN: 抽象用法只保留「公开宣告的路线」这一层，背后并没有法律强制力。

intro.en: The phrase joins environment, from Old French environ 'around', and policy, from Greek politeia 'citizenship, government' through Latin politia. The combination is a twentieth-century fixed term. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个短语由 environment 与 policy 组成：前者来自古法语 environ「四周」，后者来自希腊 politeia「公民身份、治理」，经拉丁 politia 传入。整个组合是 20 世纪的固定术语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Environ 'around' came from en 'in' plus viron 'circle'; the deeper origin of viron is not established.
items.cn: environ「四周」由 en「在内」加 viron「圈」构成；viron 的更远来源未得到证明。

items.en: Environment first meant 'the act of surrounding', then 'surrounding conditions'; its modern ecological sense is nineteenth-century.
items.cn: environment 最初指「围绕的动作」，继而指「周围状况」；其现代生态义形成于 19 世纪。

items.en: Polis 'city' gave politeia 'citizenship, constitution, government', the abstract side of city life.
items.cn: polis「城邦」构成 politeia「公民身份、政体、治理」，是城邦生活的抽象一面。

items.en: Latin politia and French policie split into two English branches: policy, a chosen course of action, and police, the force that enforces order.
items.cn: 拉丁 politia 与法语 policie 分成英语的两支：policy 指选定的行动路线，police 指维持秩序的警力。

items.en: Environmental policy became a standard term with the environmental legislation of the 1960s and 1970s, when agencies were created to enforce it.
items.cn: 随着 20 世纪六七十年代的环境立法与执法机构建立，environmental policy 成为标准术语。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper origin): no single earliest citation for the fixed phrase is agreed, and the pre-French origin of viron is unsettled, so any reconstructed form is a hypothesis.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词源）：这一固定短语的最早书证没有公认答案，viron 在法语之前的来源亦未确定，任何重构形式都只是假说。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same root as policy that are constantly mixed up; group two holds neighbouring terms for the rules themselves.
note.cn: 第一组是与 policy 同根、极易混淆的词；第二组是指规则本身的相邻术语。

entries.definition: The activity of competing for power, from the same Greek polis: politics is the struggle, policy is the chosen line that follows.
entries.definitionCN: 争夺权力的活动，同出希腊 polis：politics 是争斗过程，policy 是争斗之后选定的路线。

entries.definition: A state or organised society seen as a political body; it names the community, not a rule.
entries.definitionCN: 作为政治体看待的国家或有组织社会；它指共同体，而非某条规则。

entries.definition: The force that keeps order; it shares the Greek source with policy but split off as the enforcement branch.
entries.definitionCN: 维持秩序的警力；与 policy 同出希腊语源，但分出去成为执法的一支。

entries.definition: To make an issue a matter of political dispute; the opposite of settling it by a standing policy.
entries.definitionCN: 使某个议题成为政治争端；与用既定政策解决它相反。

entries.definition: The enacted statutes and court rules themselves; policy is the intention, law is the enforceable text.
entries.definitionCN: 已颁行的法规与判例规则本身；policy 是意图，law 是可执行的文本。

entries.definition: A specific binding rule issued under a statute; one policy usually contains many regulations.
entries.definitionCN: 依法律发布的具体约束性规则；一项政策通常包含许多规章。

entries.definition: The part of environmental policy concerned with protected areas and species, narrower than the whole.
entries.definitionCN: 环境政策中涉及保护地与物种的部分，范围比整体更窄。

entries.definition: The operational practice of running sites and audits to meet environmental goals, downstream of policy.
entries.definitionCN: 为达成环境目标而运行场地与审核的实务操作，位于政策的下游。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real set phrases and real word relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: environ means around, so environment is the ring of conditions around us.
normal.cn: environ 表示「四周」，所以 environment 就是我们周围那圈条件。

normal.en: policy and police share polis but split: one is a chosen course, the other enforcement.
normal.cn: policy 与 police 同出 polis 却分成两支：一个是被选定的路线，一个是执法。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the levels: national environmental policy, corporate environmental policy.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出层级：国家环境政策、企业环境政策。

normal.en: The pair with law is useful: policy is intent, environmental law is enforceable text.
normal.cn: 与 law 的对照很有用：policy 是意图，environmental law 是可执行的文本。

normal.en: The relative environmentalist names the person who pushes for such policy.
normal.cn: 同族词 environmentalist 指推动这类政策的人。

abstract.en: Picture a treaty signed by four neighbours who share one river.
abstract.cn: 想象四个共享一条河的邻国签下同一份协定。

examples.en: Environmental policy shifted from cleaning rivers to preventing pollution at the source.
examples.cn: 环境政策从清理河流转向从源头预防污染。

examples.en: No single state can set environmental policy for a shared sea.
examples.cn: 任何单一国家都无法为一片共享的海域制定环境政策。

examples.en: The firm's environmental policy promised audits but funded none.
examples.cn: 这家企业的环境方针承诺审核，却没有为此拨款。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「environment（周围）+ policy（政策）」——给周围环境立规矩 → 环境政策

root: environment 来自古法语 environ「四周」（en + viron），policy 来自希腊 politeia「治理」经拉丁 politia 与法语 policie；viron 与 politeia 的更深来源不确定。英语短语 environmental policy。

sensesIntro.en: Eight meanings follow one phrase from the government's course of action to its instruments, its cross-border and corporate forms, its local and conservation strands, its academic study and finally any declared stance.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一短语展开：从政府的行动路线到执行工具，再到跨国与企业形态、地方与保育分支、学术研究，最后是任何公开表明的态度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one map circled in red, with rules written in the margin.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张被红笔圈注的地图，页边写着规则。

branches.en: COURSE TO TOOLS: goals are written first, then permits and taxes make them bite.
branches.cn: 从路线到工具：先写下目标，再用许可与税费让它生效。

branches.en: BORDERLESS PROBLEMS: air and rivers ignore frontiers, so policy must be agreed across them.
branches.cn: 无界问题：空气与河流不顾边界，政策因此必须跨边界议定。

branches.en: VOLUNTARY CODE: a company borrows the phrase for promises it writes to itself.
branches.cn: 自愿守则：企业借用这个短语，指它对自己写下的承诺。

branches.en: LAND AND LIFE: zoning and reserves are the oldest, most concrete strand.
branches.cn: 土地与生命：分区与保护区是最古老、最具体的一支。

branches.en: FROM RULE TO STANCE: study and loose talk both drop the enforcement, keeping only the declared line.
branches.cn: 从规则到态度：研究与宽泛用法都去掉强制力，只留公开宣告的路线。

intro.en: Both halves are built from small pieces: environ plus -ment on one side, polis through politeia on the other.
intro.cn: 两半都由小部件构成：一边是 environ 加 -ment，另一边是 polis 经 politeia 而来。

latinIntro.en: Latin politia and politicus give policy, politics and political; the French element environ gives environment and environmental.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 politia 与 politicus 衍生 policy、politics 与 political；法语成分 environ 衍生 environment 与 environmental。

items.example: environment is the state of being surrounded.
items.exampleCN: environment 就是被环绕的状态。

items.example: The polis set its own rules.

definition_zh: adj. 热情洋溢的；溢于言表的；（岩石）喷出的
definition_en: showing much more feeling or praise than seems necessary; poured out freely
core_image: 机场出口一位老人张开双臂抱住刚回来的孙女，连声道谢的话说了一长串，排队的人都停下来看；地质标本上一块黑色玄武岩带着流动的气孔纹
scene: 机场出口处，一位老人张开双臂抱住刚回来的孙女，连声说了十几句感谢的话，排队的人都停下来看。 Her welcome was so effusive that the whole queue stopped to watch.
sceneCN: 这里 effusive 指「表现出远超必要的感情或赞美」（第 1 个义项：热情洋溢的）；句意是她的欢迎太过热情，整条队伍都停下来看。图中可辨识物件：张开的双臂、行李箱、排队的人。

pos.zh: 热情洋溢的；溢于言表的；（岩石）喷出的

senses.title: Overflowing with feeling
senses.definition: showing much more feeling or praise than seems necessary
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）表现出远超必要的感情或赞美
senses.example: Her welcome was so effusive that the whole queue stopped to watch.
senses.exampleCN: 她的欢迎太过热情，整条队伍都停下来看。
senses.why: An old man with both arms open around a girl beside a suitcase at an airport gate.
senses.whyCN: 机场出口一位老人张开双臂抱住一个女孩，旁边放着行李箱。

senses.title: Poured out freely
senses.definition: expressed in a free and unrestrained outpouring
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）以毫无拘束的倾泻方式表达出来的
senses.example: The letter ran to six effusive pages about a single afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 那封信为了一个下午的事写了六页热情洋溢的话。
senses.why: Six handwritten pages spread over a table, every line crowded with words.
senses.whyCN: 六页手写信摊在桌上，每一行都挤满了字。

senses.title: Poured out as lava
senses.definition: formed from lava poured out over the surface, used of igneous rock
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）由喷出地表的熔岩形成的，用于火成岩
senses.example: The cliff is built of effusive basalt with frozen bubbles in every layer.
senses.exampleCN: 这道崖壁由喷出玄武岩构成，每一层都带着凝固的气孔。
senses.why: A black rock face pocked with small round holes left by escaping gas.
senses.whyCN: 一面黑色岩壁布满小圆孔，那是气体逸出留下的。

intro.en: Effusive adds the adjective suffix -ive to Latin effusus, poured out; what pours out may be thanks, praise or lava.
intro.cn: effusive 是在拉丁语 effusus（被倒出的）上加形容词后缀 -ive；倒出来的可以是感谢、赞美，也可以是熔岩。

items.en: Latin fundere means to pour.
items.cn: 拉丁语 fundere 意为倾倒。

items.en: The participle effusus means poured out.
items.cn: 分词 effusus 意为被倒出的。

items.en: English formed effusive with -ive for feeling poured out without restraint.
items.cn: 英语在 17 世纪用 -ive 构成 effusive，指毫无拘束倾泻而出的感情。

items.en: Writers used effusive for praise and thanks that ran over the top.
items.cn: 作家用 effusive 指过头的赞美与感谢。

items.en: Geologists used effusive for rock formed from lava poured over the surface.
items.cn: 地质学家用 effusive 指由喷出地表的熔岩形成的岩石。

items.en: Effusive became the standard word for an overheated welcome.
items.cn: effusive 成为形容过热欢迎的标准用词。

note.en: Effusive and profuse both end in -fuse, from Latin fundere, to pour; effusive points at feeling while profuse points at quantity.
note.cn: effusive 与 profuse 都以 -fuse 结尾，来自拉丁语 fundere（倾倒）；effusive 指感情，profuse 指数量。

dict_mnemonic.text: effusive ＝ ef-（向外）＋ fus（倾倒，拉丁 fundere）＋ -ive（形容词后缀，有…性质的）＝「往外倒的」。把感情往外倒 → 热情洋溢的、溢于言表的，常带一点「过头了」的意味：effusive praise 溢于言表的赞美、an effusive welcome 热情的欢迎。同一家族：effuse 动词「流出」、effusion 名词「流出；迸发；积液」、effusively 副词、effusiveness 名词。地质学里 effusive rock 指喷出岩（熔岩倒出地表冷凝），与 intrusive 侵入岩相对。近义 gushing 更口语、更贬；demonstrative 中性，指感情外露；profuse 只说数量大（profuse thanks 连声道谢），不评价是否过头。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外）＋ fundere（倾倒）→ effusus（被倒出的）＋ -ive → effusive（热情洋溢的）

definition_zh: 批发商；批发企业
definition_en: a trader or firm that buys goods in large lots from producers and sells them on to shops
core_image: 一只大漏斗：上游整车倒进来，下游分给许多小店，漏斗自己不做零售
scene: 天刚亮，整箱水果从产地车卸到批发商的摊位上，小店的车再把这些箱子分走。 The wholesaler buys by the truckload and sells by the crate.
sceneCN: 批发市场的摊位前，整箱水果从产地车卸下，再由小店的车分装带走；句中的 wholesaler 指「从生产者大批进货、转售给零售商的批发商」（第 1 个义项：处在供应链中间、只与店铺打交道的商人）。图中可辨识物件：产地货车、整箱水果、摊位、小推车。

senses.title: Trader between producer and shop
senses.titleCN: 从生产者大批进货、转售给零售商的批发商
senses.definition: a merchant who buys in bulk from producers and sells to retailers in smaller but still wholesale lots
senses.definitionCN: 从生产者处大批买进、再以较小的整批规模卖给零售商的商人
senses.example: The wholesaler buys by the truckload and sells by the crate.
senses.exampleCN: 批发商按整车买进，按整箱卖出。
senses.why: the agent suffix on the trade name marks the person who lives by selling whole lots.
senses.whyCN: 行业名加上表施动者的后缀，指以整批出售为生的人。

senses.title: A firm in the chain
senses.titleCN: 供应链中间环节的批发企业
senses.definition: a company whose business is to hold stock and supply many shops
senses.definitionCN: 以持有存货并向多家店铺供货为业务的公司
senses.example: The wholesaler keeps three months of stock in its depot.
senses.exampleCN: 这家批发企业的仓库常备三个月的存货。
senses.why: the role survives as a company rather than a person, and the word covers both.
senses.whyCN: 这一角色以公司而非个人的形式延续下来，而这个词两者都能指。

senses.title: Trader in one commodity
senses.titleCN: 经营某一类商品的批发商
senses.definition: a bulk trader specialising in a single line, such as grain, medicine or fruit
senses.definitionCN: 专营某一类商品（如粮食、药品或水果）的批发商
senses.example: A grain wholesaler sets the price that mills pay.
senses.exampleCN: 粮食批发商定下磨坊要付的价格。
senses.why: specialising narrows the role, so the commodity name is simply attached in front of it.
senses.whyCN: 专业化使角色收窄，于是把商品名直接加在它前面即可。

senses.title: Cash-and-carry operator
senses.definition: a wholesaler that lets small shops pay on the spot and carry the goods away themselves
senses.definitionCN: 允许小店当场付款、自行把货带走的批发商
senses.example: The cash-and-carry wholesaler serves corner shops without delivery.
senses.exampleCN: 这家现购自运批发商服务街角小店，但不送货。
senses.why: the trade may drop delivery and credit while keeping the bulk role, and a phrase marks that variant.
senses.whyCN: 批发可以省去送货与赊账而保留整批角色，这个变体用固定说法来标明。

senses.title: The middle party
senses.titleCN: 站在生产与零售之间的中间方
senses.definition: the party that stands between maker and shop and takes a margin for the service
senses.definitionCN: 站在制造商与店铺之间、靠这项服务赚取差价的一方
senses.example: Removing the wholesaler did not lower prices as promised.
senses.exampleCN: 去掉批发商并没有像承诺的那样压低价格。
senses.why: because the role is defined by position, it can be discussed as an obstacle or a convenience without naming a firm.
senses.whyCN: 这一角色由位置来定义，因此不必指名某家公司，也能把它当作障碍或便利来讨论。

senses.title: Bulk seller of energy
senses.titleCN: 向供电公司成批转售电力的能源批发商
senses.definition: a company that buys power or gas in bulk and resells it to suppliers or large users
senses.definitionCN: 成批买下电力或燃气、再转售给供应商或大用户的公司
senses.example: An energy wholesaler hedges the winter load in advance.
senses.exampleCN: 能源批发商会提前对冬季负荷做对冲。
senses.why: the word spreads to any market where blocks of a commodity change hands between firms.
senses.whyCN: 一词扩散到任何企业之间成块买卖大宗商品的市场。

senses.title: The bulk stage of a supply chain
senses.titleCN: 供应链中承担整批集散的那一环
senses.definition: the stage that gathers output from many producers and distributes it to many shops
senses.definitionCN: 把众多生产者的产出汇集起来、再分给众多店铺的那个阶段
senses.example: The wholesaler stage adds the cost of storage and transport.
senses.exampleCN: 批发商这一环加上了仓储与运输的成本。
senses.why: economics describes the chain in stages, and the trader's name became the name of the stage.
senses.whyCN: 经济学把链条分段描述，商人的名字于是成了这一阶段的名字。

senses.title: Any party that aggregates supply
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何把零散供应汇集起来再分出去的一方
senses.definition: any intermediary that collects scattered supply into one place and passes it on
senses.definitionCN: 任何把零散的供应汇集到一处再传出去的中介
senses.example: The platform acts as a wholesaler of attention.
senses.exampleCN: 这个平台充当注意力的批发商。
senses.why: strip away the goods and the shape remains: gather small lots, hold them, hand them out in bigger ones.
senses.whyCN: 把货物抽掉，形状仍在：收拢零散的小份、持有一段时间、再以大份发出去。

intro.en: Wholesaler is the agent noun of wholesale, itself a compound of whole and sale. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: wholesaler 是 wholesale 的施动名词，而 wholesale 由「整」与「卖」两个本族词合成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Hāl 'entire, unhurt' is the ancestor of whole, and the 'entire' sense entered the compound.
items.cn: hāl「完整的、未损的」是 whole 的祖先，进入复合词的是「完整」这一义。

items.en: Sala 'a sale, a transfer for money' is the ancestor of sale.
items.cn: sala「买卖、以物换钱的转让」是 sale 的祖先。

items.en: The compound named the selling of a whole lot; its trade meaning is recorded from the late Middle Ages.
items.cn: 这个复合词指整批售出，其行业义在中世纪末已有记载。

items.en: Adding the suffix that marks a person or firm produced wholesaler, the one who sells by the whole lot.
items.cn: 加上表人或机构的后缀，构成 wholesaler，即按整批出售的一方。

items.en: With industrial distribution the wholesaler became a distinct firm with depots, delivery fleets and credit terms.
items.cn: 随着工业化流通，批发商成为拥有仓库、车队与赊账条件的独立企业。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same compound that are easily swapped; group two holds other names for a trading intermediary.
note.cn: 第一组是同出该复合词、容易互换的词；第二组是交易中介的其他称呼。

entries.definition: The activity or price level of bulk selling; the longer word names the party that performs it.
entries.definitionCN: 指整批出售的活动或价格层级；较长的那个词指执行它的那一方。

entries.definition: The business of selling in bulk, seen as a process rather than as a person.
entries.definitionCN: 把整批出售看作一项业务过程，而不是一个人。

entries.definition: The trader who sells single items to the public; the two names mark opposite ends of the chain.
entries.definitionCN: 把单件商品卖给公众的商人；两个名称标出链条的两端。

entries.definition: The plain noun for a transfer of goods for money, one half of the compound behind the name.
entries.definitionCN: 指以物换钱的普通名词，是该名称背后复合词的一半。

entries.definition: A firm that supplies shops, often under a brand contract; a wholesaler is defined by bulk buying rather than by appointment.
entries.definitionCN: 向店铺供货、常受品牌合同约束的公司；批发商以大批进货为定义，而不以授权为定义。

entries.definition: An older British term for a wholesaler who buys from importers and sells to retailers.
entries.definitionCN: 较旧的英式说法，指从进口商买进、卖给零售商的批发商。

entries.definition: Any party that provides goods, often directly to the user; it does not imply resale to shops.
entries.definitionCN: 任何提供货物的一方，常直接卖给使用者；并不含转售给店铺之意。

entries.definition: A neutral name for any trader between producer and buyer, including a wholesaler.
entries.definitionCN: 对生产者与买家之间任何商人的中性称呼，批发商是其中之一。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real compound, the real agent suffix and the real trade phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的复合词、真实的施动后缀与真实的行业搭配。

normal.en: Wholesale plus the person suffix: the one who sells whole lots.
normal.cn: 批发一词加上表人的后缀：卖整批货的那一方。

normal.en: The pair wholesaler and retailer face each other across the shop door.
normal.cn: 批发商与零售商隔着店铺的门相对而立。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: cash-and-carry wholesaler, food wholesaler, wholesaler margin.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出这个词：现购自运批发商、食品批发商、批发商毛利。

normal.en: A jobber is the older British cousin of the wholesaler.
normal.cn: jobber 是批发商较旧的英式同义词。

normal.en: The wholesaler never sells one apple; it sells the box.
normal.cn: 批发商从不卖一个苹果，它卖一整箱。

abstract.en: Picture a wide funnel that catches truckloads and lets crates out at the bottom.
abstract.cn: 想象一只宽漏斗接住整车货物，从底下放出一箱箱货。

abstract.en: Picture a reservoir that holds the season's water and lets it out to many small canals.
abstract.cn: 想象一座水库蓄住一季的水，再放给许多小渠。

abstract.en: Picture a warehouse that never opens a box, only moves whole pallets.
abstract.cn: 想象一间从不拆箱、只搬整托盘的仓库。

examples.en: The wholesaler's depot holds stock that no single shop could afford to keep.
examples.cn: 批发商的仓库持有任何一家店都无力囤积的存货。

examples.en: Small shops depend on the wholesaler for credit as much as for goods.
examples.cn: 小店依赖批发商的，不只是货，还有赊账。

examples.en: Cutting out the wholesaler shifts storage costs onto the retailer.
examples.cn: 去掉批发商，就把仓储成本转给了零售商。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「whole（整）+ saler（卖的人）」——整批卖货的人 → 批发商

root: 英语本族复合词 wholesale（whole「完整」＋sale「买卖」）加表施动者的后缀构成，指按整批出售的一方；与拉丁语无同族关系。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses circle one role: the party that gathers large lots and passes them on, whether as a person, a firm, a stage or a metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一个角色：把大批货汇集起来再传出去的一方，它可以是一个人、一家公司、一个环节，也可以是一个比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wide funnel that receives truckloads and releases crates.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只宽漏斗接住整车货物，再从底下放出整箱。

branches.en: THE PARTY: the trader and the firm are the same role seen as a person and as an organization.
branches.cn: 当事方：商人与人手下的公司，是同一角色在个人与组织两个层面的呈现。

branches.en: SPECIALISATION: one line or one payment style narrows the bulk role without changing it.
branches.cn: 专业化：专营一类货或改用现款自运，只收窄整批角色而不改变它。

branches.en: POSITION: defined by standing between maker and shop, the role can be praised, blamed or costed as a stage.
branches.cn: 位置：因站在制造商与店铺之间而被定义，这一角色可被称赞、指责或按环节计价。

branches.en: OTHER MARKETS: power and gas show that the role does not need physical goods.
branches.cn: 其他市场：电力与燃气说明这一角色不需要实物商品。

branches.en: PURE SHAPE: gather small lots and hand out bigger ones, with nothing left but the movement.
branches.cn: 纯形状：收拢小份、发出大份，最后只剩下这一动作本身。

intro.en: The word is a native compound plus an agent suffix, so it is read as three English morphemes.
intro.cn: 这个词是本族复合词加一个施动后缀，可按三个英语语素来读。

latinIntro.en: No Latin entries apply: the whole word is built from inherited Germanic material.
latinIntro.cn: 不适用拉丁条目：整个词都由承继的日耳曼语材料构成。

items.example: The whole lot is sold in one deal.

items.structure: sale (Old English sala, 'a transfer for money')
items.exampleCN: 一张发票记录了这笔买卖。

items.meaning: the person or firm that acts
items.example: The suffix turns the trade into the trader.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把行业名变成从业者。

items.example: The wholesaler fills the depot before winter.
items.exampleCN: 批发商在入冬前把仓库备满。

items.example: Wholesaling needs a large floor area.
items.exampleCN: 批发业务需要很大的场地。

items.example: The harvest was wholesaled in advance.
The wholesale price is printed on the docket.

definition_zh: n. 电影摄影师，摄影指导
definition_en: the person who plans and controls the camera work and lighting of a film
core_image: 片场里一个人盯着监视器决定光线
scene: 摄影师决定用逆光拍摄这场雨戏。 The cinematographer chose backlight for the rain scene.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：cinematographer 指电影摄影师；句意是摄影师决定用逆光拍这场雨戏。

senses.title: The film camera chief
senses.definition: the person in charge of camera work and lighting on a film
senses.definitionCN: 负责影片摄影与布光的负责人
senses.example: The cinematographer tested three lenses.
senses.exampleCN: 摄影师试了三个镜头。
senses.why: Greek kinema means movement and graphein means to write.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 kinema 意为运动，graphein 意为书写。

senses.title: Any camera artist on a shoot
senses.definition: a camera operator or artist credited with the look of a production
senses.definitionCN: 负责一个制作画面效果的摄影者
senses.example: The documentary used a single cinematographer.
senses.exampleCN: 这部纪录片只用了一位摄影师。
senses.why: The title widened from film to any moving-image work.
senses.whyCN: 这个头衔从电影扩大到任何动态影像作品。

intro.en: Cinematographer joins Greek kinema, movement, with graphein, to write.
intro.cn: cinematographer 由希腊语 kinema（运动）与 graphein（书写）组合而成。

items.en: Kinema means movement.
items.cn: kinema 意为运动。

items.en: Graphein means to write.
items.cn: graphein 意为书写。

items.en: Cinema names moving pictures.
items.cn: 十九世纪 cinema 指活动影像。

items.en: The title names the camera chief.
items.cn: 二十世纪片尾字幕用此头衔。

items.en: The role is treated as an art.
items.cn: 二十世纪摄影被视为艺术。

items.en: The title covers digital work too.
items.cn: 现代也涵盖数字拍摄。

note.en: The look-alike group varies the -grapher ending; the near-meaning group names film crew roles.
note.cn: 形近组变化 -grapher 词尾；近义组列出片场职务。

entries.definition: The art of film camera work.
entries.definitionCN: 电影摄影艺术。

entries.definition: A designer of dance movement.
entries.definitionCN: 编舞者。

entries.definition: Relating to film.
entries.definitionCN: 电影的。

entries.definition: A person who operates a camera.
entries.definitionCN: 摄影师。

entries.definition: The person who leads a film.
entries.definitionCN: 导演。

entries.definition: A person who cuts and assembles film.
entries.definitionCN: 剪辑师。

normalIntro.en: A cinematographer writes movement with light and a lens.
normalIntro.cn: 电影摄影师用光和镜头来写运动。

normal.en: Kinema means movement.
normal.cn: kinema 意为运动。

normal.en: Graphein means to write.
normal.cn: graphein 意为书写。

normal.en: A cinematographer writes moving pictures.
normal.cn: 摄影师书写活动画面。

normal.en: Light is the ink.
normal.cn: 光是墨水。

normal.en: The lens is the pen.
normal.cn: 镜头是笔。

abstract.en: A painter who never stops time.
abstract.cn: 从不让时间停下的画家。

abstract.en: Choosing what the dark hides.
abstract.cn: 决定黑暗藏起什么。

abstract.en: The eye behind the eye of the film.
abstract.cn: 影片之眼后面的那只眼。

examples.en: The cinematographer lit the room with one lamp.
examples.cn: 摄影师只用一盏灯照亮房间。

examples.en: She worked as a cinematographer for a decade.
examples.cn: 她做了十年电影摄影。

examples.en: The cinematographer framed the shot very wide.
examples.cn: 摄影师把这场戏拍得很宽。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「西尼玛托格拉夫」——西边的片场里，写光的人。

root: 希腊语 kinema（运动）+ graphein（书写）→ 英语 cinematographer

sensesIntro.en: The camera chief writes with light, and the title now covers digital shoots as well.
sensesIntro.cn: 摄影指导用光书写，这个头衔如今也涵盖数字拍摄。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure beside a monitor adjusting a single lamp
core.cn: 核心意象：监视器旁调一盏灯的身影

branches.en: A thumb on a light meter.
branches.cn: 按在测光表上的拇指。

branches.en: Gels clipped over a lamp.
branches.cn: 夹在灯前的色纸。

branches.en: A camera carried through a crowd.
branches.cn: 穿过人群的摄影机。

branches.en: A monitor glowing in the dark.
branches.cn: 暗处发亮的监视器。

branches.en: Light arranged until it becomes a story.
branches.cn: 被安排成故事的光。

intro.en: Cinematographer joins movement to writing; the list below adds words of light, image and film.
intro.cn: cinematographer 把「运动」与「书写」连起来；下面列出光、影像与影片词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Greek phos is light and eikon is an image.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 phos 意为光，eikon 意为影像。

latinEntries.example: Kinema is the first element of cinema.
latinEntries.exampleCN: kinema 是 cinema 的第一部分。
graphein 产生 graphic 与 photograph。
lumen 产生 luminous 与 luminary。

definition_zh: v. 把…献给；把（时间、精力）用于；致力；题献；为…举行落成礼
definition_en: to give time, effort or yourself entirely to a purpose, or to offer something to a person or cause
core_image: 一个人把整段人生像一本书一样放到某个目标的祭坛上
scene: 她把一生都献给了教学。 She dedicated her life to teaching.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：dedicate 指把时间精力全部投入；句意是她把一生献给了教学。

pos.zh: 把…献给；把…用于；致力；题献；为…举行落成礼

senses.title: Give yourself to a cause
senses.definition: to give all your time and energy to a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 把全部时间与精力投入某个目标
senses.example: She dedicated her life to teaching.
senses.exampleCN: 她把一生献给了教学。
senses.why: A whole life placed on one altar.
senses.whyCN: 整整一生被放到一座祭坛上。

senses.title: Set something apart for a use
senses.definition: to reserve something for a particular purpose
senses.definitionCN: 把某物留作特定用途
senses.example: The room is dedicated to quiet study.
senses.exampleCN: 这个房间专供安静自习。
senses.why: A space fenced off for one task.
senses.whyCN: 一块被围起来只做一件事的空间。

senses.title: Offer a book to someone
senses.definition: to write that a book or song is offered to a person
senses.definitionCN: 在书上写明把作品献给某人
senses.example: He dedicated the novel to his mother.
senses.exampleCN: 他把这部小说题献给母亲。
senses.why: A name written on the first page as a gift.
senses.whyCN: 第一页上写着一个名字，当作礼物。

senses.title: Open a building formally
senses.definition: to hold a ceremony marking a building as ready for use
senses.definitionCN: 举行仪式宣布建筑正式启用
senses.example: The mayor dedicated the new library.
senses.exampleCN: 市长为新图书馆主持落成礼。
senses.why: A ribbon cut and a door handed over.
senses.whyCN: 彩带剪断，门被交出去。

intro.en: Dedicate comes from Latin dedicare, to proclaim, from de- plus dicare, to make known.
intro.cn: dedicate 源自拉丁语 dedicare（宣告奉献），由 de- 加 dicare（宣告）构成。

items.en: Dicare meant to make known or proclaim.
items.cn: dicare 意为宣告、使知晓。

items.en: Dicere meant to say, the same family as dicare.
items.cn: dicere 意为说，与 dicare 同族。

items.en: Dedicare meant to devote something to a god.
items.cn: dedicare 意为把某物奉献给神。

items.en: Dedicate entered English for offering to a patron.
items.cn: 十五世纪 dedicate 以献给赞助人义进入英语。

items.en: Dedicate was used for formal opening ceremonies.
items.cn: 十七世纪 dedicate 用于正式落成仪式。

items.en: Dedicate widened to giving time and effort.
items.cn: 十九世纪 dedicate 扩展到投入时间与精力。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dic- saying family; the near-meaning group names giving yourself to something.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dic-（说）家族；近义组都是「把自己交给某事」的说法。

entries.definition: To say words for someone to write down.
entries.definitionCN: 口述；命令。

entries.definition: To show or point something out.
entries.definitionCN: 表明；指出。

entries.definition: Fine and easily broken or harmed.
entries.definitionCN: 精致的；易损的。

entries.definition: To give time or effort entirely to something.
entries.definitionCN: 奉献；致力于。

entries.definition: To promise to give yourself to a task.
entries.definitionCN: 承诺；投入。

entries.definition: To declare something sacred or set apart.
entries.definitionCN: 奉献；使神圣。

entries.definition: To promise seriously to do something.
entries.definitionCN: 保证；发誓。

normalIntro.en: Dedicate is de- plus dicare, to proclaim: say openly that this belongs to one purpose.
normalIntro.cn: dedicate 就是 de- 加 dicare（宣告）：公开宣布这件事只属于一个目标。

normal.en: Dicare means to proclaim.
normal.cn: dicare 意为宣告。

normal.en: De- adds completeness.
normal.cn: de- 加上彻底的意思。

normal.en: Dedicate is a public giving.
normal.cn: dedicate 是一次公开的交付。

normal.en: A book is dedicated on page one.
normal.cn: 书的题献写在第一页。

normal.en: A life dedicated has one aim.
normal.cn: 被奉献的一生只有一个目标。

abstract.en: A whole life placed on one altar.
abstract.cn: 整整一生被放到一座祭坛上。

abstract.en: A space fenced off for one task.
abstract.cn: 一块被围起来只做一件事的空间。

abstract.en: A name written on the first page as a gift.
abstract.cn: 第一页上写着一个名字，当作礼物。

examples.en: He dedicated the album to his late father.
examples.cn: 他把这张专辑献给已故的父亲。

examples.en: She dedicates two hours a day to reading.
examples.cn: 她每天抽出两小时读书。

examples.en: The hall was dedicated last spring.
examples.cn: 这座礼堂去年春天举行落成礼。

dict_mnemonic.text: dedicate 谐音「戴迪凯特」——不如记 de（彻底）＋ dic（说，与 dictate 同根）＋ ate（动词）＝彻底说定「这个归它」，「献给、致力」。

root: 拉丁语 dicare（宣告）→ dedicare（奉献给神）→ 拉丁语 dedicatus → 英语 dedicate

sensesIntro.en: One altar: a life, a room, a first page and a new door.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一座祭坛：一生、一间房、第一页与一扇新门。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole life placed like a book on one altar
core.cn: 核心意象：整整一生像一本书那样被放到一座祭坛上

branches.en: A whole life placed on one altar.
branches.cn: 整整一生被放到一座祭坛上。

branches.en: A space fenced off for one task.
branches.cn: 一块被围起来只做一件事的空间。

branches.en: A name written on the first page as a gift.
branches.cn: 第一页上写着一个名字，当作礼物。

branches.en: A ribbon cut and a door handed over.
branches.cn: 彩带剪断，门被交出去。

branches.en: All four set something apart and declare whom it belongs to.
branches.cn: 四者都把某物分别出来，并宣告它属于谁。

intro.en: Dedicate is de- plus dicare; the saying root builds many declaring words.
intro.cn: dedicate 由 de- 加 dicare 构成；说这个词根造出许多宣告类词。

latinIntro.en: Latin dicare means to proclaim and dicere means to say.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dicare 意为宣告，dicere 意为说。

definition_zh: 使震惊；使大吃一惊
definition_en: to shock someone deeply with something unexpected
core_image: 一声雷在头顶炸开，全场的人张大了嘴
scene: 礼堂的灯亮起，幕布拉开，评委席上没有人料到下一秒的歌声。 The singer's final high note would astound the entire panel.
sceneCN: 这里 astound 是「使震惊」（第 1 个义项：因意外而深深震撼）；句意为歌手最后的高音将令全体评委震惊。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加形容词后缀构成，义为「令人震惊的」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「惊人地」
同族近形词，义为「使惊讶」

senses.title: To shock with the unexpected
senses.definition: to overwhelm someone with sudden surprise
senses.definitionCN: 以突来的意外彻底震住某人
senses.example: The verdict astounded the courtroom.
senses.exampleCN: 判决令整个法庭愕然。
senses.why: The Latin root ex-tonare means to thunder out; the shock lands like thunder.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 ex-tonare 意为雷声炸响；震惊正如惊雷落地。

senses.title: To overwhelm with wonder
senses.definition: to fill someone with amazed admiration
senses.definitionCN: 以惊叹与叹服充满内心
senses.example: The acrobats astounded everyone with their balance.
senses.exampleCN: 杂技演员的平衡技令所有人叹服。
senses.why: Thunder becomes awe when the surprise is also splendid.
senses.whyCN: 当意外同时精彩绝伦，惊雷便化作惊叹。

intro.en: Astound arose in English around the seventeenth century, blending astonish and stun, both from Latin ex-tonare, to thunder out.
intro.cn: astound 约于十七世纪在英语中出现，混合了 astonish 与 stun，二者均源自拉丁语 ex-tonare（如雷声般炸响）。

items.en: The root *(s)ten- meant to thunder or resound.
items.cn: 词根 *(s)ten- 意为打雷、轰鸣。

items.en: Extontanare meant to thunder out, to stun.
items.cn: 拉丁语 extontanare 意为如雷炸响、令人失神。

items.en: Estoner passed into English as astonish.
items.cn: 古法语 estoner 进入英语成为 astonish。

items.en: Stun developed as a native short form of the thunder idea.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语中 stun 发展为「雷击般失神」的简短形式。

items.en: Astound blended the two, first as a past participle, then a full verb.
items.cn: 十七世纪 astound 由二者混合而成，先作过去分词，后成完整动词。

note.en: Astound fuses astonish and stun: thunder written twice over.
note.cn: astound 融合 astonish 与 stun：同一声惊雷写了两遍。

entries.definition: to surprise greatly, slightly milder
entries.definitionCN: 使惊讶（同根，程度稍轻）

entries.definition: to daze with a blow or shock
entries.definitionCN: 使目瞪口呆（同根短形式）

entries.definition: shockingly impressive
entries.definitionCN: 惊人的（同根形容词）

entries.definition: similar shape, means to be plentiful, different root
entries.definitionCN: 大量存在（形近，词源不同）

entries.definition: as if struck by lightning with surprise
entries.definitionCN: 如遭雷击般震惊（同意象合成词）

entries.definition: to upset with sudden bad news
entries.definitionCN: 使震惊（多指坏消息）

entries.definition: to overwhelm with shock
entries.definitionCN: 使动摇；震惊

entries.definition: to surprise utterly
entries.definitionCN: 使大吃一惊（口语）

entries.definition: to leave someone speechless
entries.definitionCN: 使哑然

entries.definition: to fill with wonder
entries.definitionCN: 使惊奇

normalIntro.en: Read astound as a-STUN-d: a stun so strong it adds a thunder clap.
normalIntro.cn: 把 astound 读作 a-STUN-d：在 stun 之上再加一声惊雷。

normal.en: blend of astonish and stun.
normal.cn: 由 astonish 与 stun 混合而成。

normal.en: tonare means thunder, as in detonate.
normal.cn: tonare 意为打雷，如 detonate。

normal.en: astonish is the milder sibling.
normal.cn: astonish 是较温和的兄弟词。

normal.en: astounding describes shocking facts.
normal.cn: astounding 形容惊人的事实。

normal.en: usually a strong, positive or dramatic surprise.
normal.cn: 通常指强烈或戏剧性的意外。

abstract.en: Picture a courtroom gasping at a verdict.
abstract.cn: 想象法庭因判决而集体倒吸凉气。

abstract.en: Hear one huge drumbeat in silence.
abstract.cn: 听寂静中响起一声巨鼓。

abstract.en: Feel the floor drop from under your certainties.
abstract.cn: 体会脚下的笃定忽然塌陷。

examples.en: The magician's escape astounded the police.
examples.cn: 魔术师的脱身令警察惊愕。

examples.en: Sales figures astounded the board.
examples.cn: 销售数字令董事会震惊。

examples.en: She astounded her teachers with fluent Greek.
examples.cn: 她流利的希腊语令老师们惊叹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额死淘的」——消息一来额吓得死淘（跌坐）在地，即 astound 之震惊。

root: 拉丁语 ex-tonare（雷声炸响）→ 古法语 estoner → 英语 astonish 与本土 stun → 十七世纪混合为 astound（使震惊）。

sensesIntro.en: One thunder image grows into shock and into amazed admiration.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一声惊雷，既炸出惊愕，也炸出叹服。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thunderclap in a silent hall
core.cn: 核心意象：寂静礼堂里的一声惊雷

branches.en: stunning with bad or huge news
branches.cn: 被重大消息震住

branches.cn: 对技艺或美的叹服

intro.cn: 雷声词根把震惊表现为一声巨响的打击。

latinIntro.en: Latin tonare, to thunder, powers astonish, stun and astound alike.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tonare（打雷）同时驱动 astonish、stun 与 astound。

definition_zh: 把（工作、工序、职能）外包；向外部供应商购买（服务或部件）
definition_en: to arrange for an outside supplier or another country to do work that could be done internally
core_image: 一只手把一叠待办工作递出窗口，窗外的人接过并立刻开始干活
scene: 项目经理把整块测试工作递给窗外的团队，自己只留下验收清单。 The firm outsources payroll so that a specialist handles the tax filings.
sceneCN: 项目经理隔着窗把一叠测试任务递出去，只留下验收清单；句中的 outsource 指「把某项工作交给外部方承做」（第 1 个义项：把本可自做的工作移交给外部供应商）。图中可辨识物件：工作清单、窗口、文件夹、验收表。

senses.title: Move a whole job outside
senses.titleCN: 把整项工作交给外部承做
senses.definition: to give an entire piece of work to an outside organization instead of doing it in house
senses.definitionCN: 把整项工作交给外部机构，而不是在内部完成
senses.example: The firm outsources payroll so that a specialist handles the tax filings.
senses.exampleCN: 公司把薪酬发放外包出去，让专门机构处理报税。
senses.why: the verb is the action behind the noun: the source of the work is placed outside.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词是名词背后的动作：工作的来源被放到外面。

senses.title: Contract out one task
senses.titleCN: 把某一具体任务分包出去
senses.definition: to give one defined task, such as translation or testing, to an outside contractor
senses.definitionCN: 把一项界定明确的任务（如翻译或测试）交给外部承包商
senses.example: They outsourced the translation of the manual to a local agency.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把手册翻译外包给了本地一家机构。
senses.why: the verb can take a single task as its object, not only a whole department.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词的宾语可以是一项任务，而不必是一整个部门。

senses.title: Buy components from outside
senses.titleCN: 从外部供应商购买零部件
senses.definition: to obtain parts or materials from an outside maker rather than producing them
senses.definitionCN: 从外部制造商取得零件或材料，而不是自行生产
senses.example: The carmaker outsources the seats but builds its own engines.
senses.exampleCN: 这家车企外购座椅，却自造发动机。
senses.why: in manufacturing, what leaves is not a service but a piece of the product, and the verb covers it.
senses.whyCN: 在制造业，被移出去的不是服务，而是产品的一部分，这个动词也涵盖这种情况。

senses.title: Send jobs abroad
senses.definition: to move work and jobs to a lower-cost country
senses.definitionCN: 把工作与岗位移到成本更低的国家
senses.example: The plant outsourced assembly to a factory across the border.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂把组装外包给了边境另一侧的工厂。
senses.why: location is often the point of the verb in public debate, even though it is not part of the word's shape.
senses.whyCN: 在公共争论中，地点常是这个动词的重点，尽管它并不在词形之中。

senses.title: Hand over an IT function
senses.titleCN: 把信息技术职能交给外部服务商
senses.definition: to transfer systems, support or development to an external technology provider
senses.definitionCN: 把系统、技术支持或开发转交给外部技术提供商
senses.example: The bank outsources its data backup to a cloud firm.
senses.exampleCN: 银行把数据备份外包给一家云服务公司。
senses.why: technology was the first field to make the verb routine, so an IT object is one of its most common uses.
senses.whyCN: 技术领域最早让这个动词成为日常用语，因此以信息技术为宾语是其最常见用法之一。

senses.title: Hand over manufacturing
senses.titleCN: 把生产环节交给外部工厂
senses.definition: to have goods made by another company, often under contract and to one's specification
senses.definitionCN: 让另一家公司按合同与规格生产自己的货物
senses.example: The brand outsources all its clothing to three factories.
senses.exampleCN: 这个品牌把全部服装交给三家工厂生产。
senses.why: the object may be the making of a product, not just its parts.
senses.whyCN: 宾语可以是产品的制造过程，而不只是零件。

senses.title: Hand over a service
senses.titleCN: 把某项服务（客服、物流、薪酬）交给外部
senses.definition: to have a service delivered by a specialist rather than by one's own staff
senses.definitionCN: 让专业公司提供服务，而不是由自己的员工来做
senses.example: Small clinics outsource billing to keep overheads low.
senses.exampleCN: 小型诊所把账单处理外包，以压低管理费用。
senses.why: services are invisible, yet they move outside the firm in exactly the same way as goods.
senses.whyCN: 服务是无形的，但它们移出企业的方式与货物完全相同。

senses.title: Delegate a decision
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：把判断或决策交给外部方
senses.definition: to let an outside party or tool make a judgment one could make oneself
senses.definitionCN: 让外部一方或工具作出自己本可作出的判断
senses.example: It is risky to outsource editorial judgment to an algorithm.
senses.exampleCN: 把编辑判断外包给算法是有风险的。
senses.why: the verb's shape allows any object: once judgment can be moved outside, it too can be outsourced.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词的词形允许任何宾语：一旦判断可以被移到外部，它也能被外包。

intro.en: Outsource is a back-formation from outsourcing, coined in late twentieth-century business writing and built on out plus source. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: outsource 是由 outsourcing 逆构而成的动词，产生于二十世纪后期的商业写作，由「向外」与「来源」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Surgere 'to rise, spring up' combines the prefix for 'from below' with a verb meaning 'to lead straight'.
items.cn: surgere「升起、涌出」把表示「从下方」的前缀与意为「引导直行」的动词组合起来。

items.en: Sourse 'a spring, the place where water rises' is the ancestor of the English noun source.
items.cn: sourse「泉眼、水涌出之处」是英语名词 source 的祖先。

items.en: Source widened to any point of origin, including the supplier of goods or work.
items.cn: source 扩展到任何起源点，包括货物或工作的供应方。

items.en: The noun naming the practice appeared in the 1970s and spread widely in the 1980s and 1990s.
items.cn: 指这种做法的名词在二十世纪七十年代出现，并在八九十年代广泛传播。

items.en: Speakers then clipped the noun to form the verb outsource, treating the ending as if it were a suffix.
items.cn: 随后使用者从名词中截出动词 outsource，把词尾当作后缀去掉。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same 'rise' root and the same compound; group two holds verbs of handing work to others.
note.cn: 第一组同出「升起」词根或同一复合结构；第二组是把工作交给他人的动词。

entries.definition: The practice or arrangement of moving work outside; the verb names the act of doing it.
entries.definitionCN: 把工作移到外部的做法或安排；动词指做出这一动作。

entries.definition: The point something comes from; the verb moves that point beyond the organization.
entries.definitionCN: 事物来源的起点；这个动词把该起点移到组织之外。

entries.definition: A supply available for use, from the same rising root with a prefix meaning 'again'.
entries.definitionCN: 可供使用的资源，同出该「升起」词根，前缀意为「再」。

entries.definition: To rise suddenly, from the same Latin verb of rising that gave source.
entries.definitionCN: 突然升起，同出给出 source 的那个拉丁语「升起」动词。

entries.definition: To give a specific contracted task to another firm; narrower than to outsource.
entries.definitionCN: 把合同中一项具体任务交给另一家公司；比 outsource 范围窄。

entries.definition: To hand a task and its authority to a person, usually inside the same organization.
entries.definitionCN: 把任务与权限交给一个人，通常在同一组织内部。

entries.definition: An informal verb for sending work to others, often used of repetitive tasks.
entries.definitionCN: 把工作送交他人的口语说法，常用于重复性任务。

entries.definition: To have a service provided by an outside firm under contract, common in government.
entries.definitionCN: 按合同让外部公司提供某项服务，常见于政府用语。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real compound, the real verb phrases and the real root family.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的复合结构、真实的动词搭配与真实词根家族。

normal.en: Out plus source: put the source of the work outside the firm.
normal.cn: 「向外」加「来源」：把工作的来源放到企业之外。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: outsource production, outsource services, outsource payroll.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出这个词：外包生产、外包服务、外包薪酬发放。

normal.en: The family runs outsource, outsourcing, outsourced and outsourcer.
normal.cn: 同族词包括外包、外包做法、已外包的与承接方。

normal.en: Outsource answers who does the work; offshore answers where.
normal.cn: 外包回答谁来做，离岸回答在哪里做。

normal.en: The verb is a back-formation: the noun came first, the verb was cut from it.
normal.cn: 这个动词是逆构词：名词先出现，动词由它截成。

abstract.en: Picture a hand passing a stack of papers through a window.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把一叠文件递出窗口。

abstract.en: Picture a tap whose water is redirected to another garden.
abstract.cn: 想象一只水龙头的水被改道流向另一座花园。

abstract.en: Picture a mind that lets a machine choose for it.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗心让机器替它作选择。

examples.en: They outsource the night shift to a security firm.
examples.cn: 他们把夜班外包给一家安保公司。

examples.en: The publisher outsources printing but keeps editing in house.
examples.cn: 出版社外包印刷，却把编辑留在内部。

examples.en: It is unwise to outsource a decision you cannot audit.
examples.cn: 把无法审计的决策外包出去并不明智。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「out（向外）+ source（来源）」——把活的来源挪到外面 → 外包

root: 由名词 outsourcing 逆构而成，由 out（向外）＋source（来源）构成。source 经古法语 sourse（泉眼）来自拉丁语 surgere（升起），该动词由表示「从下方」的前缀与意为「引导直行」的词根构成。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow the same verb applied to different objects: a task, a part, a job, a system, a product, a service and finally a judgment.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项是同一个动词施加在不同宾语上：一项任务、一个零件、一个岗位、一套系统、一件产品、一项服务，最后是一个判断。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of work passed out through a window.
core.cn: 核心意象：一叠工作从窗口递了出去。

branches.en: WHOLE JOB OR SINGLE TASK: the verb takes either scope without changing meaning.
branches.cn: 整项工作或单一任务：动词对两种范围都适用，意义不变。

branches.en: PARTS AND PRODUCTS: manufacturing shows that objects can be handed over at any stage.
branches.cn: 零件与产品：制造业说明，任何阶段的物件都可以被交出去。

branches.en: THE BORDER: location enters public debate even though it is not in the word.
branches.cn: 国界：地点进入公共争论，尽管它并不在词形里。

branches.en: SYSTEMS AND SERVICES: invisible work moves out exactly as goods do.
branches.cn: 系统与服务：无形的工作与货物一样移出。

branches.en: JUDGMENT: the final object is not work but the right to decide.
branches.cn: 判断：最后的宾语不是工作，而是决定权。

intro.en: The word is an English adverb plus an English noun of French and Latin origin; it is read as a compound, not as a suffixed stem.
intro.cn: 这个词由一个英语副词加一个源自法语与拉丁语的英语名词构成，应按复合词而非词缀派生来读。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root surgere gives source, resource and surge; out is English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语词根 surgere 给出「来源」「资源」与「涌起」；「向外」这一半来自英语。

items.example: The first half sends the action outward.
items.exampleCN: 前半部分把动作推向外面。

items.example: The firm found a cheaper source.
items.exampleCN: 企业找到了更便宜的来源。

items.meaning: the practice of moving work out
items.meaningCN: 把工作移到外部的做法
items.example: Outsourcing saved the firm a floor of staff.
items.exampleCN: 外包让企业省掉一层楼的员工。

items.meaning: the firm that takes the work on
items.example: The outsourcer employs two thousand agents.
items.exampleCN: 承接方雇有两千名坐席。

items.example: The prefix inside source gives the image of rising water.
items.exampleCN: 来源一词内部的前缀带来水向上涌的画面。

items.example: The Latin verb is the base of source.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁动词是「来源」的底座。

definition_zh: n. 下降；下坡；血统；世系；（突然）袭击
definition_en: an act of going down, a family origin, or a sudden attack
core_image: 登山者沿陡坡一步步往下，家谱树一层层往下分叉，族谱上写着祖籍
scene: 下山用了两个小时。 The descent took two hours.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：descent 指下降；句意是下山用了两个小时。

pos.zh: 下降；下坡；血统；世系；（突然）袭击

senses.title: Going down
senses.definition: the act of moving from a higher to a lower place
senses.definitionCN: 从高处移到低处的行为
senses.example: The descent took two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 下山用了两个小时。
senses.why: A climber stepping down a steep slope.
senses.whyCN: 一个沿陡坡一步步往下的登山者。

senses.title: A downward slope
senses.definition: a slope or path that goes down
senses.definitionCN: 往下走的坡或路
senses.example: The road makes a sharp descent to the bay.
senses.exampleCN: 这条路陡降到海湾。
senses.why: A road dropping in switchbacks to the water.
senses.whyCN: 一条以之字形落到水边的路。

senses.title: Family origin
senses.definition: the family or country that a person comes from
senses.definitionCN: 一个人所来自的家族或国家
senses.example: She is of Irish descent.
senses.exampleCN: 她是爱尔兰裔。
senses.why: A family tree branching downwards on paper.
senses.whyCN: 纸上一棵往下分叉的家谱树。

senses.title: A sudden attack
senses.definition: a sudden visit or attack by a group
senses.definitionCN: 一群人突然的到访或袭击
senses.example: The police made a descent on the warehouse.
senses.exampleCN: 警方突袭了那座仓库。
senses.why: Boats landing on a beach before dawn.
senses.whyCN: 天亮前抢滩登陆的船。

intro.en: Descent comes from Latin descensus, from descendere, de- plus scandere, to climb: a climbing down.
intro.cn: descent 源自拉丁语 descensus，来自 descendere，由 de- 加 scandere（攀登）构成：往下爬。

items.en: Scandere meant to climb.
items.cn: scandere 意为攀登。

items.en: Descendere meant to climb down.
items.cn: descendere 意为往下爬。

items.en: Descensus named the act of going down.
items.cn: descensus 指下降这一行为。

items.en: Descent entered English for going down.
items.cn: 十三世纪 descent 以下降义进入英语。

items.en: It came to name family lineage.
items.cn: 十四世纪转而指家族世系。

items.en: It also named a sudden landing or attack.
items.cn: 十七世纪也指突然登陆或袭击。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the scend- climbing family; the near-meaning group names other downward things.
note.cn: 形近组共享 scend-（攀登）家族；近义组是其他「往下」的说法。

entries.definition: To move from a higher to a lower place.
entries.definitionCN: 下降。

entries.definition: A person descended from an ancestor.
entries.definitionCN: 后裔。

entries.definition: The act of going up.
entries.definitionCN: 上升。

entries.definition: A fall to a lower level.
entries.definitionCN: 下降；落差。

entries.definition: The line of ancestors a person comes from.
entries.definitionCN: 世系。

entries.definition: A sudden attack on a place.
entries.definitionCN: 突袭。

normalIntro.en: Descent is de- down plus scend- climb: a climbing down, whether a slope, a family tree or an attack.
normalIntro.cn: descent 就是 de-（向下）加 scend-（攀登）：往下爬，无论是坡、家谱还是袭击。

normal.en: Scend- means to climb, as in ascend.
normal.cn: scend- 意为攀登，如 ascend。

normal.en: De- means down.
normal.cn: de- 表示向下。

normal.en: The descent took two hours.
normal.cn: 下山用了两个小时。

normal.en: Of Irish descent means Irish ancestry.
normal.cn: of Irish descent 指爱尔兰血统。

normal.en: A descent on a place is a sudden raid.
normal.cn: a descent on a place 指突然袭击。

abstract.en: A climber stepping down a steep slope.
abstract.cn: 一个沿陡坡一步步往下的登山者。

abstract.en: A road dropping in switchbacks to the water.
abstract.cn: 一条以之字形落到水边的路。

abstract.en: A family tree branching downwards on paper.
abstract.cn: 纸上一棵往下分叉的家谱树。

examples.en: The plane began its descent at noon.
examples.cn: 飞机中午开始下降。

examples.en: Two descents were logged by the rescue team.
examples.cn: 救援队记录了两次下撤。

examples.en: His family is of Italian descent.
examples.cn: 他家是意大利裔。

dict_mnemonic.text: descent 源自拉丁语 descendere：de-（向下）＋ scandere（攀登）＝往下爬。名词 descent 既指「下降、下坡」，也指家谱往下传的「血统」，还指突然扑下来的「突袭」。

root: 拉丁语 scandere（攀登）→ de-＋scandere → descendere（往下爬）→ descensus → 英语 descent

sensesIntro.en: One going down: a slope, a family tree and a landing at dawn.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一次往下：一段坡、一棵家谱树与一次天亮前的登陆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a climber stepping down a steep slope while a family tree branches downwards on paper
core.cn: 核心意象：登山者沿陡坡一步步往下，纸上的家谱树一层层往下分叉

branches.en: A climber stepping down a steep slope.
branches.cn: 一个沿陡坡一步步往下的登山者。

branches.en: A road dropping in switchbacks to the water.
branches.cn: 一条以之字形落到水边的路。
