branches.en: Both move from high ground to low.
branches.cn: 两者都从高处移到低处。

intro.en: Descent is de- plus scend-; the climbing root builds the up-and-down family.
intro.cn: descent 由 de- 加 scend- 构成；攀登这个词根造出上下两族词。

latinIntro.en: Latin scandere means to climb, descendere to climb down and gradus a step.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 scandere 意为攀登，descendere 意为往下爬，gradus 意为步。

definition_zh: 供暖；供暖系统；加热过程；加热的；供暖的
definition_en: the process or system of making a place or object warm
core_image: 冬夜里暖气片慢慢变烫，窗玻璃上结着霜，屋里的空气一点点暖起来
scene: 冬天的客厅里，住户把温控器调高了一档，说 The heating comes on at six every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 heating 指「建筑物里的供暖系统」（第 1 个义项：由锅炉或热泵把热量送进房间的一整套设备）；句意为暖气每天早上六点启动。图中可辨识物件：暖气片、温控器、结霜的窗玻璃。

pos.zh: 供暖；供暖系统；加热过程（不可数）

collocations.zh: 全球变暖（强调人为加热）

forms.label: 名词（不可数，通常无复数）

senses.title: The system that warms a building
senses.definition: the equipment, such as a boiler or heat pump, that supplies warmth to rooms
senses.definitionCN: 向房间供应暖气的设备，如锅炉或热泵
senses.example: The heating failed during the coldest night of the year.
senses.exampleCN: 一年中最冷的那个夜里，供暖系统坏了。
senses.why: The gerund names an activity, but a household turns that activity into a permanent installation, so 'the heating' became the system itself.
senses.whyCN: 动名词本指一项活动，但家庭把这项活动变成常设设备，于是「the heating」就指系统本身。

senses.title: The process of raising temperature
senses.definition: the act or process of making something warmer, especially in a controlled way
senses.definitionCN: 使某物变暖的动作或过程，尤指受控地进行
senses.example: Gentle heating keeps the mixture from separating.
senses.exampleCN: 缓慢加热可以防止混合物分层。
senses.why: This is the plain verbal noun: any instance of the verb heat plus the action suffix -ing.
senses.whyCN: 这是最普通的动词名词化：动词 heat 加表示动作的后缀 -ing。

senses.title: The cost or fuel of warmth
senses.definition: the money spent on, or the energy consumed by, warming a home
senses.definitionCN: 为住宅供暖花掉的钱或消耗的能源
senses.example: Heating accounts for half of their winter bills.
senses.exampleCN: 供暖占他们冬季账单的一半。
senses.why: Once 'the heating' means the system, its running cost is metonymically called heating too.
senses.whyCN: 一旦「the heating」指系统，它的运行开销也就以借代方式同样叫作 heating。

senses.title: Global heating
senses.titleCN: 全球变暖（强调人为加热）
senses.definition: the ongoing rise in global temperature caused by human greenhouse-gas emissions
senses.definitionCN: 由人类温室气体排放引起的全球气温持续上升
senses.example: Some scientists prefer 'global heating' because it names an active process.
senses.exampleCN: 一些科学家更愿意用「全球加热」，因为它点明这是一个主动过程。
senses.why: The climate term was coined to stress that the change is driven by people, not by a natural cycle.
senses.whyCN: 这一气候术语的造词意图是强调变化由人推动，而不是自然循环。

senses.title: Industrial process heating
senses.definition: the use of furnaces, induction or steam to bring materials to a required temperature in manufacturing
senses.definitionCN: 制造业中用炉窑、感应或蒸汽把材料升到所需温度
senses.example: Induction heating hardens the metal without distorting it.
senses.exampleCN: 感应加热能在不变形的情况下使金属硬化。
senses.why: Industry borrowed the household word for a technical process because the aim is the same: controlled warmth.
senses.whyCN: 工业借用了家庭里的词来指技术过程，因为目的相同：受控的加热。

senses.title: A heating element
senses.definition: the part of an appliance that converts electricity or gas into heat
senses.definitionCN: 把电或燃气转化为热的器具部件
senses.example: The heating element glowed orange behind the fan.
senses.exampleCN: 风扇后面的加热元件发出橙色的光。
senses.why: Shortened from 'heating element', the participle works as a modifier: the part whose job is heating.
senses.whyCN: 由 heating element 缩略而来，分词作定语：职责就是加热的那个部件。

senses.title: Designed to warm something
senses.definition: used before a noun to describe a device or surface whose purpose is to supply warmth
senses.definitionCN: 置于名词前，说明某装置或表面的用途是供热
senses.example: She plugged in the heating pad and put it on her back.
senses.exampleCN: 她插上电热垫，把它放在背上。
senses.why: The participle keeps its verbal force: a heating pad is literally a pad for heating.
senses.whyCN: 分词保留了动词意味：heating pad 字面就是「用来加热的垫子」。

senses.title: Laboratory heating
senses.definition: the controlled use of a burner or hot plate to warm a substance in an experiment
senses.definitionCN: 实验中用本生灯或加热板受控地加热物质
senses.example: The label warns against direct heating of the sealed tube.
senses.exampleCN: 标签警告不要直接加热密封管。
senses.why: Laboratory usage keeps the process sense pure: no installation, no bill, only a controlled rise in temperature.
senses.whyCN: 实验室用法保留了纯粹的过程义：没有设备系统，也没有账单，只有受控的升温。

intro.en: Heating is a transparent English formation: the native noun and verb heat plus the old Germanic suffix -ing. Nothing in it is borrowed.
intro.cn: heating 是透明的英语构词：本族名词兼动词 heat 加古老的日耳曼后缀 -ing，没有任何借词成分。

items.en: Heat goes back to Old English hǣtu, formed from hāt 'hot'; the verb hatian 'to make hot' existed beside it.
items.cn: heat 上溯古英语 hǣtu，由 hāt「热的」构成；旁边已有动词 hatian「使变热」。

items.en: The suffix -ing (in Old English also -ung) turned verbs into nouns of action, as it still does in heating and cooling.
items.cn: 后缀 -ing（古英语中亦作 -ung）把动词变成表示动作的名词，heating 与 cooling 至今如此。

items.en: From the Middle English period the -ing form served both as a participle and as a noun naming an ongoing action.
items.cn: 从中古英语时期起，-ing 形式既作分词，也作名词指正在进行的动作。

items.en: With central heating in the nineteenth century, 'the heating' shifted from an action to the installed equipment of a house.
items.cn: 19 世纪出现集中供暖后，「the heating」从一项动作转指住宅里已安装的设备。

items.en: Global heating is a late twentieth-century coinage; its exact first use is recorded only loosely, so the date is uncertain.
items.cn: global heating 是 20 世纪晚期的造词；确切的最早使用只有粗略记载，因此首见年代存疑。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same family that are easy to swap by mistake; group two holds words about warmth and air control with a different scope.
note.cn: 第一组是同一词族中极易误换的形式；第二组是涉及温暖与空气调节、范围不同的词。

entries.definition: The bare noun or verb for warmth itself; heating adds the suffix and names the process or the installation.
entries.definitionCN: 指热本身的名词或动词原形；heating 加了后缀，指过程或设备。

entries.definition: The participle or adjective meaning 'made warm' or 'emotionally intense', not the ongoing system.
entries.definitionCN: 分词或形容词，意为「被加热的」或「情绪激烈的」，不是正在运行的供暖系统。

entries.definition: A countable device that produces warmth, such as a room heater; heating is the system or process as a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 可数的产热装置，如房间取暖器；heating 指整体系统或过程。

entries.definition: An old word for a pagan, from Old English hǣthen; it only looks as if it belonged to the heat family.
entries.definitionCN: 旧时指异教徒的词，来自古英语 hǣthen；只是看起来像属于 heat 词族。

entries.definition: A gradual, often pleasant increase in temperature; heating is usually deliberate and mechanical.
entries.definitionCN: 逐渐且常令人舒适的温度上升；heating 通常是有意为之、由设备完成的。

entries.definition: The removal of heat, the mirror image of heating; the two are studied together in thermodynamics.
entries.definitionCN: 移走热量，是 heating 的镜像过程；两者在热力学中一起研究。

entries.definition: The supply of fresh air to a space; it may cool a room but does not itself generate heat.
entries.definitionCN: 向空间供给新鲜空气；它可能让房间变凉，但本身不产生热。

entries.definition: Material that slows heat loss; it works with heating rather than replacing it.
entries.definitionCN: 减缓热量散失的材料；它与供暖配合，而不是替代供暖。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: a real suffix, real compounds and real household collocations, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的后缀、真实的复合词与真实的家庭搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: heat + -ing: the suffix turns the action into a noun, exactly as in cooling and warming.
normal.cn: heat + -ing：后缀把动作变成名词，与 cooling、warming 完全一样。

normal.en: Household phrases mark the system sense: central heating, heating system, heating bill.
normal.cn: 家庭搭配标出系统义：集中供暖、供暖系统、供暖账单。

normal.en: The same family runs heat, heated, heater, heating.
normal.cn: 同一词族包括 heat、heated、heater、heating。

normal.en: Global heating is the climate variant of global warming, chosen to stress human cause.
normal.cn: global heating 是 global warming 的气候变体，选它为了强调人为原因。

normal.en: The heating comes on and goes off with the thermostat, like a switchable noun.
normal.cn: 暖气随温控器开合，就像这个可切换的名词。

abstract.en: Picture a metal radiator ticking as it expands, the sound of a house waking up.
abstract.cn: 想象金属暖气片受热膨胀时发出轻响，那是一栋房子醒来的声音。

abstract.en: Picture a blanket of warm air settling over a room while frost climbs the window.
abstract.cn: 想象一层暖空气落满房间，而霜正爬满窗户。

abstract.en: Picture a kettle's coil turning from grey to orange, doing nothing but making warmth.
abstract.cn: 想象水壶的线圈从灰变橙，只做一件事：制造温暖。

examples.en: They turned the heating down before leaving for the holidays.
examples.cn: 出门度假前他们把暖气调低了。

examples.en: Slow heating preserves the flavour of the sauce.
examples.cn: 缓慢加热能保住酱汁的风味。

examples.en: The new building uses solar heating instead of gas.
examples.cn: 这栋新楼用太阳能供暖，而不是燃气。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「热厅」——把大厅热起来，靠的就是供暖

root: 英语本族构词：heat（古英语 hǣtu，由 hāt「热的」构成）加日耳曼语动作后缀 -ing。表示「供暖系统」的用法在 19 世纪集中供暖普及后固定下来；global heating 为 20 世纪晚期造词，最早书证年代存疑。无拉丁语来源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one line: the act of warming something is first a process, then the equipment that performs it, then its cost, its industrial and laboratory forms, its climate scale and finally its use as a modifier.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一条线索展开：加热先是过程，然后是执行它的设备、它的开销，再到工业与实验室形态、气候尺度，最后作定语使用。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a radiator warming a cold room while frost covers the window.
core.cn: 核心意象：暖气片把冷屋子烘暖，窗上结着霜。

branches.en: SYSTEM AND BILL: once the installation is called heating, its running cost takes the same name.
branches.cn: 系统与账单：设备一旦叫作 heating，运行开销也沿用同名。

branches.en: PURE PROCESS: both the general act and the laboratory version name only a controlled rise in temperature.
branches.cn: 纯过程：一般动作与实验室用法都只指受控升温。

branches.en: PLANETARY SCALE: the same word is stretched to the whole climate system.
branches.cn: 行星尺度：同一个词被扩展到整个气候系统。

branches.en: INDUSTRY AND PARTS: furnaces and glowing elements are the technical face of the process.
branches.cn: 工业与部件：炉窑与发光的元件是这一过程的技术面目。

branches.en: MODIFIER: as an adjective the word simply marks a device whose job is warmth.
branches.cn: 定语：作形容词时只标明某装置的职责是供热。

intro.en: Heating is heat plus the productive suffix -ing; the suffix and the root both recur across the language.
intro.cn: heating 是 heat 加能产后缀 -ing；词根与后缀在英语中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: Both parts are Germanic, so there are no Latin cognates to list; Latin calefactio is only a semantic equivalent.
latinIntro.cn: 两个成分都属日耳曼语，因此没有拉丁同族词可列；拉丁语 calefactio 只是语义对应词。

items.meaning: the act or process of doing something
items.example: Cooling follows heating in the cycle.
items.exampleCN: 在这个循环里，冷却跟在加热之后。

items.example: The heated pool stays open all winter.
items.exampleCN: 温水泳池整个冬天都开放。

items.example: The heater hummed beside the desk.
items.exampleCN: 取暖器在桌边嗡嗡作响。

items.example: Reheating rice can dry it out.

items.exampleCN: 预热模具可以防止开裂。

definition_zh: 市场结构；市场中卖者的数量与规模分布，连同进入壁垒和产品差异所构成的整体格局；产业组织理论的核心术语
definition_en: the pattern formed by the number and size distribution of sellers in a market, together with the height of entry barriers and the degree of product differentiation
core_image: 一张街区俯视图：几处摊位占地悬殊，大铺占去大半街面，小摊挤在边角，街口还横着一道进场要先交钱的栏门
scene: 一条商业街刚划好摊位，几家大铺占去大半街面，小摊只能挤在边角，街口还立着一道进场要先交钱的栏门，谁进得来、谁占得宽，一眼就能看出。 Economists use the term market structure to describe this layout of sellers.
sceneCN: 同一条街上，卖者的数量、各自占地的宽窄、进场的门槛高低，合起来构成一幅可比的格局。句中的 market structure 指「卖者数量与规模分布连同进入壁垒所形成的格局」（第 1 个义项：卖者构成与规模分布的整体形态）。图中可辨识物件：摊位俯视图、占地界线、门槛、价目牌。

pos.zh: 市场结构（指格局与形态，可数；不同产业各有其结构）

collocations.phrase: the market structure of an industry

senses.title: How many sellers, and how big
senses.titleCN: 卖者的数量与规模分布
senses.definition: the count of firms serving a market and the range of sizes among them
senses.definitionCN: 为同一市场供货的厂商数目，以及它们规模大小的分布
senses.example: A market structure with two hundred small bakeries differs sharply from one with three large mills.
senses.exampleCN: 两百个小面包坊构成的市场结构，与三家大磨坊构成的结构截然不同。
senses.why: structure means the way parts are put together, so the phrase first asks what parts a market contains and how much room each occupies.
senses.whyCN: structure 指各部分被组合起来的方式，因此这个短语首先问的是：一个市场由哪些部分组成，每一部分占多大位置。

senses.title: Concentration of market share
senses.titleCN: 份额向少数厂商集中的程度
senses.definition: the share of the market held by the largest firms, and whether that share is spread or piled up
senses.definitionCN: 最大几家厂商所占的份额，以及该份额是分散还是堆积在一处
senses.example: The market structure is highly concentrated, with four firms holding most of the sales.
senses.exampleCN: 该市场结构高度集中，四家厂商握有大部分销量。
senses.why: once the sizes are known, the next structural question is how they add up: a few large blocks or many small ones make different shapes.
senses.whyCN: 一旦知道规模，下一个结构问题便是它们如何加总：几块大石与一堆小石形成不同的形状。

senses.title: The height of entry barriers
senses.definition: the cost, legal obstacle or technical requirement that a newcomer must meet to start selling
senses.definitionCN: 新来者要开始销售必须跨过的成本、法律障碍或技术要求
senses.example: Licensing rules and a costly pipeline give the incumbents a market structure that few challengers can enter.
senses.exampleCN: 执照规则与昂贵的管线成本，使在位者拥有一个少有挑战者能进入的市场结构。
senses.why: a structure is held up by walls as much as by contents, and the wall around a market is the barrier that keeps new sellers out.
senses.whyCN: 结构的维持既靠内容也靠围墙，而市场周围的围墙就是挡住新卖者的壁垒。

senses.title: The degree of product differentiation
senses.definition: how far rival sellers offer goods that buyers treat as distinct rather than interchangeable
senses.definitionCN: 相互竞争的卖者所提供的货物，被买方视为有区别而非可互换的程度
senses.example: Branding gives shampoo a market structure in which each label is a separate niche.
senses.exampleCN: 品牌化使洗发水形成一种市场结构，每个标签都是一个独立的细分位。
senses.why: differentiation changes the shape of a market because a market of identical goods behaves like one block, while a market of distinct goods behaves like many.
senses.whyCN: 差异化会改变市场的形状，因为同质货物市场如同一整块，而彼此有别的货物市场则像许多块。

senses.title: A type in the competition typology
senses.titleCN: 按竞争程度划分的类型标签
senses.definition: a category such as perfect competition, oligopoly or monopoly assigned to a market by its seller pattern
senses.definitionCN: 依据卖者格局给市场指定的类别，如完全竞争、寡头或垄断
senses.example: Textbooks label the airline market structure as an oligopoly because a few carriers dominate each route.
senses.exampleCN: 教科书把航空市场结构标为寡头，因为每条航线都由少数承运者主导。
senses.why: because the phrase describes a shape, it became the name of a shelf of shapes, and each shelf is a textbook type rather than a single case.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个短语描述形状，它便成了存放各种形状的架子名，每一格都是一类教科书类型，而非单一实例。

senses.title: An index used in merger review
senses.titleCN: 合并审查中可测量的指标
senses.definition: a measurable summary of seller shares, such as a concentration ratio, used by regulators to judge a proposed merger
senses.definitionCN: 对卖者份额的可测概括，如集中率，供监管机构评判拟议合并
senses.example: Regulators computed the post-merger market structure before allowing the deal.
senses.exampleCN: 监管机构先算出合并后的市场结构，才允许这笔交易。
senses.why: competition law needs a number rather than a diagram, so the phrase shifted from a description of shape to a statistic that can be computed.
senses.whyCN: 竞争法需要数字而非图样，于是这个短语从「形状描述」转为「可计算的统计量」。

senses.title: A shape that changes over time
senses.definition: the shifting pattern produced by entry, exit, mergers and consolidation within a market
senses.definitionCN: 由进入、退出、合并与整合在市场内造成的变化着的格局
senses.example: Deregulation altered the market structure as new carriers entered and older ones merged.
senses.exampleCN: 放松管制改变了市场结构：新承运者进入，旧承运者合并。
senses.why: the phrase can name a process as well as a snapshot, since the arrangement of sellers is never fixed and consolidation keeps redrawing it.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语既可指名一个瞬间，也可指名一个过程，因为卖者的排列从不固定，整合不断把它重画。

senses.title: A layered pattern in platform markets
senses.titleCN: 平台市场中的分层格局
senses.definition: the arrangement of a platform market into layers, where the owner of the interface and the data sits above the sellers who depend on it
senses.definitionCN: 平台市场分成若干层的排列方式：掌握接口与数据的所有者居于依赖它的卖者之上
senses.example: A marketplace app creates a market structure in which thousands of sellers depend on one ranking system.
senses.exampleCN: 一个集市应用造出一种市场结构，成千上万的卖者依赖同一套排序系统。
senses.why: structure can also mean the layering of levels, so the phrase extends naturally to markets where one firm controls the layer through which all trade passes.
senses.whyCN: structure 也可指层次的叠加，因此这个短语自然延伸到「一家公司掌管所有交易必须穿过的那个层」的市场。

intro.en: Market structure joins a Latin trade noun to a Latin building noun. Market goes back to mercatus, a place of trading built on merx 'goods'; structure goes back to structura, a fitting together, from struere 'to pile up, to build'.
intro.cn: market structure 把一个拉丁的「交易」名词与一个拉丁的「建造」名词接在一起。market 上溯 mercatus「交易场所」，基于 merx「货物」；structure 上溯 structura「拼合、构造」，出自 struere「堆叠、建造」。

items.en: Mercatus named a market and the trading done in it, formed from mercari 'to trade', which rests on merx (genitive mercis) 'goods'. The deeper origin of merx is uncertain, and older forms proposed for it are reconstructions.
items.cn: mercatus 指市场及其中进行的买卖，出自动词 mercari「做买卖」，而该动词基于 merx（属格 mercis）「货物」。merx 的更早来源不确定，为它提出的更古形式属重构形式。

items.en: Struere meant 'to pile up, to build, to arrange in order'. It is generally thought to descend from a root meaning 'to spread out', but that earlier form is a reconstruction rather than a recorded word.
items.cn: struere 意为「堆叠、建造、按序排列」。一般认为它源自表示「铺展开」的词根，但那个更早的形式是重构形式，并非有记录的词。

items.en: Structura, from struere, meant the act of building and the arrangement that results, as when stones are laid in a deliberate order rather than heaped at random.
items.cn: structura 出自 struere，指建造的动作以及由此形成的排列，就像石头被有意按序砌起，而非随意堆放。

items.en: English took structure through Old French in the fourteenth century, first as the process of building and later as the internal arrangement of parts in a body, a sentence or a society.
items.cn: 英语于十四世纪经古法语借入 structure，最初指建造过程，后来指身体、句子或社会中各部分的内部排列。

items.en: The full phrase took shape in twentieth-century industrial organization, where the arrangement of sellers was linked to their conduct and to the results a market delivers.
items.cn: 完整短语在二十世纪的产业组织理论中成形，在那里，卖者的排列被与它们的行为以及市场所交付的结果联系起来。

items.en: Source uncertain: the pre-Latin root of struere is unsettled, and the exact first use of the English phrase is not established, so any earlier citation offered for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定：struere 在拉丁语之前的词根无定论，英语短语的确切首见年代亦无定说，因此为它给出的更早书证均属重构。

note.en: Group one shares the word market and is often mistaken for the target; group two names related aspects of the same industrial landscape but at a different level of analysis.
note.cn: 第一组共用 market 一词，常被误当作目标短语；第二组指同一产业图景中的相关侧面，但分析层次不同。

entries.definition: The splitting of customers into groups with shared traits; it describes demand and marketing, not the number and size of sellers.
entries.definitionCN: 把顾客按共同特征分成若干群；它描述需求与营销，而非卖者的数量与规模。

entries.definition: The way prices and signals coordinate buyers and sellers; it explains the working of a market, not its shape.
entries.definitionCN: 价格与信号协调买卖的方式；它解释市场的运作，而非市场的形状。

entries.definition: The portion of sales held by a single firm; it is one measurement used to describe the target, not the target itself.
entries.definitionCN: 单一厂商所占的销量比例；它是描述目标格局的一项测量，而非格局本身。

entries.definition: The mix of agriculture, manufacturing and services across an economy; it works one level above the arrangement of sellers in a single market.
entries.definitionCN: 一个经济体中农业、制造业与服务业的构成；它比单一市场内卖者的排列高一个层次。

entries.definition: The degree to which output is gathered in a few firms; it measures the second dimension of the target while leaving barriers and differentiation aside.
entries.definitionCN: 产出集中于少数厂商的程度；它只测量目标格局中的第二个维度，搁下壁垒与差异化。

entries.definition: The ability of a firm to raise price without losing all its customers; it is what a given arrangement allows, not the arrangement.
entries.definitionCN: 厂商提价而不失去全部顾客的能力；它是某种格局所容许的结果，而非格局本身。

entries.definition: A single obstacle that keeps newcomers out; it is one ingredient of the target rather than the whole pattern.
entries.definitionCN: 阻挡新来者的单项障碍；它是目标格局中的一味成分，而非整个形态。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real building root behind structure, real relatives and real textbook labels.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：structure 背后真实的「建造」词根、真实同族词以及真实的教科书标签。

normal.en: Structure comes from struere 'to pile up, to build': stones laid in a deliberate order, not heaped at random.
normal.cn: structure 出自 struere「堆叠、建造」：石头被有意按序砌起，而不是随意堆成一堆。

normal.en: The same root builds construct, instruct, obstruct and infrastructure, all of which carry an idea of putting parts together.
normal.cn: 同一词根还构成 construct、instruct、obstruct 与 infrastructure，这些词都带「把部分拼起来」的意思。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the dimensions: concentrated market structure, fragmented market structure, market structure analysis.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各个维度：集中型市场结构、分散型市场结构、市场结构分析。

normal.en: The textbook shelf holds perfect competition, oligopoly and monopoly, and each is a type of market structure.
normal.cn: 教科书那一格放着完全竞争、寡头与垄断，每一种都是一个市场结构类型。

normal.en: The old triad links structure to conduct and to performance, so the shape is studied for what it makes firms do.
normal.cn: 旧有的三段式把结构、行为与绩效连在一起，研究形状是为了看它促使厂商做什么。

abstract.en: Picture an aerial photo of a market district: two warehouses, a row of kiosks and a gate at the only road in.
abstract.cn: 想象一张市场街区的俯拍：两座仓库、一排小亭，以及唯一一条进路上的一道门。

abstract.en: Picture a handful of large stones dropped into a jar of gravel: the same total weight, but a very different shape.
abstract.cn: 想象几块大石落进一罐碎石：总重一样，形状却全然不同。

abstract.en: Picture a stadium where one owner controls the gate, the seating chart and the list of who may sell snacks inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一座体育场，同一个人掌管入口、座位表以及谁能在场内卖零食的名单。

examples.en: The market structure of the region is fragmented, with no firm holding more than a tenth of sales.
examples.cn: 该地区的市场结构是分散的，没有一家厂商的销量超过一成。

examples.en: Before approving the merger, the authority asked how the deal would change the market structure.
examples.cn: 在批准合并之前，主管机关询问这笔交易将如何改变市场结构。

examples.en: Over three decades, deregulation and consolidation reshaped the market structure of the industry.
examples.cn: 三十年间，放松管制与整合重塑了该产业的市场结构。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「market（市场）+ structure（结构）」——把集市画成一张俯视图，看几个摊位、各占多宽、门口有没有门槛，这张图就是市场结构。

root: 拉丁 mercatus「市场、交易」← mercari「做买卖」← merx（属格 mercis）「货物」；拉丁 structura「建造、构造」← struere「堆叠、建造」；英语于十四世纪经古法语借入 structure，短语为二十世纪产业组织理论术语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one act of drawing: first count the sellers and weigh their sizes, then ask how the shares pile up, what wall keeps newcomers out and how unlike the goods are; the drawing is then given a textbook name, turned into an index, replayed as a film of change and finally extended to the layered architecture of a platform.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次「作图」展开：先数卖者、量大小，再问份额如何堆积、什么墙挡住新来者、货物彼此有多不同；这张图随后被赋予教科书名称、被折算成指标、被当作变化的过程重放，最后延伸到平台的分层架构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bird's-eye plan of a market district, showing how many stalls there are, how much ground each holds and where the gate stands.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张市场街区的俯视图，标出有多少摊位、各自占多宽的地面、门开在哪里。

branches.en: WHO AND HOW MUCH: the number of sellers and the way their shares stack up are the first two lines of the drawing.
branches.cn: 谁与多少：卖者的数量与份额的堆叠方式，是这张图最先画的两笔。

branches.en: WALLS AND DIFFERENCES: barriers fix who can enter, while differentiation decides whether buyers see one block or many.
branches.cn: 围墙与差异：壁垒决定谁能进来，差异化决定买方看到的是一整块还是许多块。

branches.en: NAME AND NUMBER: the same drawing is filed under a textbook type and then reduced to a computable index.
branches.cn: 名称与数字：同一张图先被归入某个教科书类型，再被约简为可计算的指标。

branches.en: TIME: entry, exit and merger keep redrawing the plan, so the structure is also a process.
branches.cn: 时间：进入、退出与合并不断重画这张图，因此结构同时是一个过程。

branches.en: LAYERS: in a platform market the drawing gains a storey, and the owner of that storey sits above every seller.
branches.cn: 层次：在平台市场中，这张图多出一层，而那一层的所有者居于所有卖者之上。

intro.en: The phrase is two Latin nouns glued together in English: a trade noun ending in -atus and a building noun ending in -ura, each with its own small family.
intro.cn: 这个短语是两个拉丁名词在英语中的并置：一个带 -atus 后缀的交易名词，一个带 -ura 后缀的建造名词，各自带着自己的小词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin struere and structura stand behind structure and its relatives; mercatus and merx stand behind market and merchant.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 struere 与 structura 在后，衍生 structure 及其亲属词；mercatus 与 merx 在后，衍生 market 与 merchant。

items.example: The root survives in commerce and merchant as well as market.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根除 market 外，还留存于 commerce 与 merchant。

items.structure: suffix forming a noun of act or result
items.meaning: the doing of something, or its outcome
items.meaningCN: 动作的进行，或动作的结果
items.example: Mercari plus the suffix gives mercatus, the trading.
items.exampleCN: mercari 加这个后缀得到 mercatus，即买卖这件事。

items.structure: Latin root in struere, 'to pile up, build'
items.meaning: to lay in order, to build
items.example: The root carries the picture of stones stacked in rows.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根带着「石头成排砌起」的画面。

items.example: Struere supplies both the building and the arranging sense.
items.exampleCN: struere 同时提供「建造」与「排列」两层意思。

items.structure: suffix forming a noun of result
items.meaning: the thing produced by an act
items.example: Struere plus the suffix yields structura, a built arrangement.
items.exampleCN: struere 加这个后缀得到 structura，即被建成的排列。

items.example: Structura named both the act of building and its result.
items.exampleCN: structura 既指建造的动作，也指其结果。

items.example: Structure moved from building work to the plan of any whole.
items.exampleCN: structure 从建造工程转指任何整体的构成。

items.meaningCN: 属于排列本身的；结构的
items.example: Structural flaws cannot be fixed by painting over them.
items.exampleCN: 结构性的缺陷无法靠刷一层漆来修补。

items.meaning: to build by putting parts together
items.example: The same root builds, and so the verb means to put together.
items.exampleCN: 同一词根意为建造，因此这个动词意为拼合。

items.example: The restructuring closed two plants and merged the sales teams.
items.exampleCN: 重组关掉两家工厂，并合并了销售团队。

definition_zh: adj. 说教的；教诲的；讲授式的；（贬）好为人师的
definition_en: intended to teach, especially a moral lesson, often in a way that feels preachy
core_image: 一本童书每页末尾都写着「这个故事告诉我们…」；老师把结论直接写在黑板上，不让学生自己推
scene: 这部小说太说教了。 The novel is too didactic.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：didactic 指说教的；句意是这部小说太说教了。

pos.zh: 说教的；教诲的；好为人师的

senses.title: Meant to teach a lesson
senses.definition: intended to teach, especially a moral lesson
senses.definitionCN: 意在教导，尤指道德教训
senses.example: The novel is too didactic.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说太说教了。
senses.why: A moral printed at the foot of every page.
senses.whyCN: 每页页脚印着的一条教训。

senses.title: Teaching by telling
senses.definition: using direct instruction rather than discovery
senses.definitionCN: 用直接讲授而非让学生自己发现
senses.example: The method is didactic rather than exploratory.
senses.exampleCN: 这种方法是讲授式的，而非探索式的。
senses.why: A conclusion written on the board before the question.
senses.whyCN: 问题之前就先写在黑板上的结论。

senses.title: Preachy in manner
senses.definition: giving instruction when it is not wanted
senses.definitionCN: 在别人不需要时仍施以教导
senses.example: He has a didactic way of answering.
senses.exampleCN: 他回答时总带着说教腔。
senses.why: A finger pointing at a chart during a casual chat.
senses.whyCN: 闲聊中一根指着图表的手指。

intro.en: Didactic comes from Greek didaktikos, apt at teaching, from didaskein, to teach, built on an ancient root meaning to take or receive.
intro.cn: didactic 源自希腊语 didaktikos（善于教学的），来自 didaskein（教），其词根是古义的「接受、领受」。

items.en: Dak was the root meaning to take or receive.
items.cn: dak 是意为接受、领受的古词根。

items.en: Didaskein meant to teach, to make someone receive.
items.cn: didaskein 意为教，即让人领受。

items.en: Didaktikos meant apt at teaching.
items.cn: didaktikos 意为善于教学的。

items.en: Didactic entered English for instructive.
items.cn: 十七世纪 didactic 以教诲义进入英语。

items.en: It gained a negative preachy sense.
items.cn: 十九世纪获得贬义的说教色彩。

items.en: Didacticism names the tendency in art.
items.cn: 如今 didacticism 指艺术中的说教倾向。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the teach family across Greek and Latin; the near-meaning group names other words for instructive or preachy.
note.cn: 形近组共享希腊语与拉丁语的「教」家族；近义组是其他表示「教诲」或「说教」的词。

entries.definition: The tendency to teach morals in art.
entries.definitionCN: 在艺术中灌输道德的倾向。

entries.definition: Ready to be taught or led; it comes from Latin docere, to teach.
entries.definitionCN: 易受教、易引导的；来自拉丁语 docere（教）。

entries.definition: A follower who learns from a teacher; from Latin discere, to learn.
entries.definitionCN: 向老师学习的追随者；来自拉丁语 discere（学）。

entries.definition: Giving useful knowledge.
entries.definitionCN: 提供有用知识的。

entries.definition: Giving moral advice in a tiresome way.
entries.definitionCN: 以令人厌烦的方式给道德劝告。

entries.definition: Intended to help people learn.
entries.definitionCN: 旨在帮助人们学习的。

normalIntro.en: Didactic is did- teach: the lesson is handed over, and sometimes handed over too hard.
normalIntro.cn: didactic 就是 did-（教）：把教训递过去，有时递得太用力。

normal.en: Did- here means teach, not do.
normal.cn: 这里的 did- 意为教，不是做。

normal.en: Didactic can be neutral or critical.
normal.cn: didactic 可中性也可带批评。

normal.en: Docile shares the teach root in Latin.
normal.cn: docile 在拉丁语里共享「教」词根。

normal.en: Didacticism is the noun for the habit.
normal.cn: didacticism 是这种习惯的名词。

normal.en: A didactic novel states its moral.
normal.cn: didactic novel 会直接说出教训。

abstract.en: A moral printed at the foot of every page.
abstract.cn: 每页页脚印着的一条教训。

abstract.en: A conclusion written on the board before the question.
abstract.cn: 问题之前就先写在黑板上的结论。

abstract.en: A finger pointing at a chart during a casual chat.
abstract.cn: 闲聊中一根指着图表的手指。

examples.en: The film is didactic but moving.
examples.cn: 这部电影说教却动人。

examples.en: She avoided a didactic tone in class.
examples.cn: 她在课堂上避免说教语气。

examples.en: His essays became more didactic with age.
examples.cn: 他的随笔随着年龄越发说教。

dict_mnemonic.text: didactic ＝ did（教，希腊语 didaskein「教」，本义「让人领受」）＋ -actic（…的）＝一心要把教训塞给你的，「说教的、教诲的」。与 docile、disciple 同出「接受」古根。

root: 希腊语 dak（接受、领受）→ didaskein（教）→ didaktikos（善于教学的）→ 英语 didactic

sensesIntro.en: One lesson handed over: a printed moral, a board conclusion and a pointing finger.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一份被递出的教训：印好的格言、黑板上的结论与一根指着图表的手指。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a moral printed at the foot of every page of a children book
core.cn: 核心意象：一本童书每页页脚都印着一条教训

branches.en: A moral printed at the foot of every page.
branches.cn: 每页页脚印着的一条教训。

branches.en: A conclusion written on the board before the question.
branches.cn: 问题之前就先写在黑板上的结论。

branches.en: A finger pointing at a chart during a casual chat.
branches.cn: 闲聊中一根指着图表的手指。

branches.en: Both give the answer before the thinking.
branches.cn: 两者都在思考之前给出答案。

branches.en: Both tell rather than invite.
branches.cn: 两者都是告知而非邀请。

intro.en: Didactic is did- teach plus -actic; the same ancient root gives Latin docere and discere.
intro.cn: didactic 由 did-（教）加 -actic 构成；同一古词根也给出拉丁语 docere 与 discere。

latinIntro.en: Latin docere means to teach, discere to learn and educare to bring up.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 docere 意为教，discere 意为学，educare 意为养育训练。

definition_zh: n. 减压；降低压力；（潜水后）减压停留；（数据）解压缩
definition_en: a reduction in pressure, or the process of returning compressed data to its original form
core_image: 一个被压紧的弹簧慢慢松开，潜水员在浅处停着让体内气泡一点点散掉
scene: 潜水员在浅处停着慢慢减压。 The diver began a slow decompression.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：decompression 指潜水后的减压；句意是潜水员开始缓慢减压。

pos.zh: 减压；降低压力；减压停留；数据解压缩

senses.title: A drop in pressure
senses.definition: a reduction of physical pressure on something
senses.definitionCN: 作用在某物上的物理压力减小
senses.example: Decompression let the gas escape slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 减压让气体慢慢逸出。
senses.why: A tight grip loosened by degrees.
senses.whyCN: 紧握的手一点点松开。

senses.title: The slow ascent of a diver
senses.definition: the staged release of pressure after a deep dive
senses.definitionCN: 深潜之后分阶段释放压力
senses.example: The diver began a slow decompression.
senses.exampleCN: 潜水员开始缓慢减压。
senses.why: Bubbles leaving the blood before the surface.
senses.whyCN: 气泡在到达水面前先离开血液。

senses.title: Unpacking data
senses.definition: the process of restoring compressed files to full size
senses.definitionCN: 把压缩文件还原成原始大小
senses.example: Decompression took only a second.
senses.exampleCN: 解压缩只花了一秒。
senses.why: A folded file opened back to its shape.
senses.whyCN: 折起的文件重新展开成原样。

intro.en: Decompression is de- plus compression, from Latin comprimere, to press together.
intro.cn: decompression 由 de- 加 compression 构成，后者源自拉丁语 comprimere（压在一起）。

items.en: Premere meant to press.
items.cn: premere 意为压。

items.en: Comprimere meant to press together.
items.cn: comprimere 意为压在一起。

items.en: Compress entered English for pressing into less space.
items.cn: 十四世纪 compress 以压入更小空间义进入英语。

items.en: Compression named the act of pressing together.
items.cn: compression 指压在一起的行为。

items.en: Decompression was used for releasing steam pressure.
items.cn: 十九世纪 decompression 用于释放蒸汽压力。

items.en: Decompression became a diving and computing term.
items.cn: 二十世纪 decompression 成为潜水与计算机术语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the press- family; the near-meaning group names release from pressure or packing.
note.cn: 形近组同属 press- 家族；近义组都是「从压力或压缩中释放」的说法。

entries.definition: The act of pressing something into less space.
entries.definitionCN: 压缩。

entries.definition: To reduce pressure or unpack data.
entries.definitionCN: 减压；解压缩。

entries.definition: To press down or make someone sad.
entries.definitionCN: 按下；使沮丧。

entries.definition: The act of setting something free.
entries.definitionCN: 释放。

entries.definition: The process of becoming larger.
entries.definitionCN: 膨胀；扩张。

entries.definition: Taking things out of a packed container.
entries.definitionCN: 拆包；解压。

entries.definition: The process of becoming less tight or tense.
entries.definitionCN: 放松；松弛。

normalIntro.en: Decompression is de- plus compression: undo the pressing.
normalIntro.cn: decompression 就是 de- 加 compression：把压紧的状态解开。

normal.en: Press means to push hard.
normal.cn: press 意为用力压。

normal.en: Compress presses things together.
normal.cn: compress 把东西压到一起。

normal.en: Compression is the pressed state.
normal.cn: compression 是被压紧的状态。

normal.en: De- reverses the pressing.
normal.cn: de- 把压紧反转过来。

normal.en: Decompression lets it all out.
normal.cn: decompression 让一切释放出来。

abstract.en: A tight grip loosened by degrees.
abstract.cn: 紧握的手一点点松开。

abstract.en: Bubbles leaving the blood before the surface.
abstract.cn: 气泡在到达水面前先离开血液。

abstract.en: A folded file opened back to its shape.
abstract.cn: 折起的文件重新展开成原样。

examples.en: Rapid decompression can injure a diver.
examples.cn: 快速减压会伤害潜水员。

examples.en: The chamber provides controlled decompression.
examples.cn: 这个舱提供可控的减压。

examples.en: File decompression finished without errors.
examples.cn: 文件解压缩顺利完成，没有报错。

dict_mnemonic.text: decompression 谐音「弟康普瑞申」——不如记 de（去掉）＋ compression（压缩）＝把压缩去掉，「减压、解压缩」。

sensesIntro.en: One loosened grip: pressure, the ascent of a diver and a packed file.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一只松开的手：压力、潜水员的上浮与打包的文件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tightened spring slowly opening back to its own length
core.cn: 核心意象：被压紧的弹簧慢慢松开，回到自己的长度

branches.en: A tight grip loosened by degrees.
branches.cn: 紧握的手一点点松开。

branches.en: Bubbles leaving the blood before the surface.
branches.cn: 气泡在到达水面前先离开血液。

branches.en: A folded file opened back to its shape.
branches.cn: 折起的文件重新展开成原样。

branches.en: Both release stored pressure safely and slowly.
branches.cn: 两者都缓慢而安全地释放储存的压力。

branches.en: Both return something squeezed back to its original size.
branches.cn: 两者都把被挤压的东西还原到原来的大小。

intro.en: Decompression is de- plus com- plus press plus -ion; the pressing family is very productive.
intro.cn: decompression 由 de- 加 com- 加 press 再加 -ion 构成；压这个家族构词能力很强。

latinIntro.en: Latin premere means to press and pandere means to spread out.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 premere 意为压，pandere 意为展开。

definition_zh: 港口；避难所；藏匿；怀有（想法或情感）；停泊
definition_en: a sheltered place where ships anchor, or to shelter, hide or hold something
core_image: 一圈防波堤把水面围住，船在里面安稳停靠
scene: 货船在黎明时驶入港口。 The cargo ships entered the harbor at dawn.
sceneCN: 这里该词指「供船只停靠的港区」（第 1 个义项：避风停泊的水域）；句意为货船在黎明时驶入港口。

senses.title: A sheltered port
senses.titleCN: 港口：供船只避风停靠的水域
senses.definition: a sheltered area of water where ships can anchor safely
senses.definitionCN: 船只可安全停泊的避风水域
senses.example: The cargo ships entered the harbor at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 货船在黎明时驶入港口。
senses.why: Old English joined 'army' and 'shelter', and the shelter later became a shelter for ships.
senses.whyCN: 古英语把「军队」与「庇护」组合，后来这种庇护变成船只的庇护。

senses.title: A place of refuge
senses.definition: a place that offers safety or rest from danger
senses.definitionCN: 提供安全或让人避开危险休息的地方
senses.example: The chapel became a harbor for travellers in the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 小教堂成了旅人在暴风雨中的避难所。
senses.why: A port protects ships from rough water; the same word extends to any protecting place.
senses.whyCN: 港口保护船只免受风浪，同一个词扩展到任何庇护之处。

senses.title: To hide someone or something
senses.definition: to give shelter to a person or thing, often secretly
senses.definitionCN: 为某人或某物提供庇护，常含秘密之意
senses.example: The barn harbored stolen tools for a week.
senses.exampleCN: 谷仓把偷来的工具藏了一个星期。
senses.why: Sheltering becomes hiding when the purpose is secrecy.
senses.whyCN: 当目的是保密时，庇护就变成藏匿。

senses.title: To hold a feeling or idea
senses.definition: to keep a thought or feeling in the mind over time
senses.definitionCN: 在心里长期保留某种想法或情感
senses.example: She harbored a quiet hope of returning.
senses.exampleCN: 她心里悄悄怀着回去的希望。
senses.why: The mind becomes a shelter that keeps a feeling safe inside it.
senses.whyCN: 心成为一个庇护所，把情感安全地保存在里面。

senses.title: To anchor in a port
senses.definition: to bring a ship into a harbor or to lie there at anchor
senses.definitionCN: 把船驶入港口或停泊在那里
senses.example: The fleet harbored before the storm reached the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 船队在暴风雨抵达海岸前进港停泊。
senses.why: The noun became a verb for the action of using the shelter.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词，表示使用这个庇护处的动作。

senses.title: The port area
senses.definition: the town or district around a port
senses.definitionCN: 港口周边的城镇或区域
senses.example: The harbor district is busy before sunrise.
senses.exampleCN: 港区在日出前就忙碌起来。
senses.why: People and trade gather around the shelter, so the word names the district as well as the water.
senses.whyCN: 人与贸易聚集在庇护处周围，因此这个词也指那片区域。

senses.title: To give refuge to people
senses.definition: to protect and shelter people in need
senses.definitionCN: 保护并收留需要帮助的人
senses.example: The town harbored families displaced by the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 小镇收留了因洪水流离失所的家庭。
senses.why: The human sense of shelter is the oldest moral use of the word.
senses.whyCN: 收留人的意义是这个词最古老的道德用法。

senses.title: To contain a virus or program
senses.definition: to carry a disease, fault or hidden program without showing it
senses.definitionCN: 携带疾病、缺陷或隐藏程序而不显露
senses.example: The file may harbor a virus.
senses.exampleCN: 这个文件可能藏有病毒。
senses.why: A hidden thing kept inside is another version of sheltering, now in biology or computing.
senses.whyCN: 被藏在里面的东西是庇护的另一版本，如今用于生物或计算机。

intro.en: Harbor is Old English, from here 'army' plus beorg 'shelter'. The spelling was later influenced by French. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 该词来自古英语，由表示「军队」与表示「庇护」的两个词构成；拼写后来受法语影响。年代均为约数。

items.en: herebeorg joined here 'army' and beorg 'shelter, protection', first naming a place where an army could lodge.
items.cn: 古英语把「军队」与「庇护、保护」组合，最初指军队可以驻扎的地方。

items.en: beorgan 'to protect, save' is the verb behind the shelter noun.
items.cn: 表示「保护、拯救」的古英语动词是「庇护」名词背后的动词。

items.en: The military sense faded, and the word came to mean a shelter for ships and then for people.
items.cn: 军事义淡化后，这个词转为船只的庇护处，再转为人的庇护处。

items.en: The ending changed under French influence, producing the modern spelling with a final -or.
items.cn: 词尾在法语影响下改变，形成现代的拼写形式。

items.en: The noun became a verb for sheltering, then for holding a thought, a disease or a hidden program.
items.cn: 名词转为动词，先指庇护，再指怀有想法、携带疾病或藏有隐藏程序。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date of the nautical sense): the shift from army shelter to port is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（航海义的首见年代）：从军队庇护转为港口的确切年代无定论。

note.en: Group one holds look-alike words, including the British spelling; group two holds the port and refuge words that overlap with harbor.
note.cn: 第一组是形近词，其中包含英式拼写；第二组是与港口或庇护语义重叠的词。

entries.definition: The British spelling of the same word; the meaning is identical, only the spelling differs.
entries.definitionCN: 这是同一个词的英式拼写；意义完全相同，只有拼写不同。

entries.definition: A sign or person that announces what is coming; it looks close but comes from a different French word.
entries.definitionCN: 指预告某事即将到来的征兆或人；形似但来自另一个法语词。

entries.definition: A shaded garden shelter or a tree; it comes from Latin for 'tree', not from the English word.
entries.definitionCN: 指花园中的荫棚或树；来自拉丁语表示「树」的词，与本词无关。

entries.definition: A place where ships load and unload; it stresses trade and facilities, while harbor stresses shelter.
entries.definitionCN: 指船只装卸货物的地方；强调贸易与设施，而本词强调庇护。

entries.definition: A safe place for ships or people; it is close to harbor but often more literary.
entries.definitionCN: 指船只或人的安全处；与本词接近，但常更带文学色彩。

entries.definition: A structure where a ship is tied to load or repair; it is a built berth, not a sheltered water area.
entries.definitionCN: 指船只系泊装卸或修理的结构；它是修建的泊位，不是避风水域。

entries.definition: A place or state of protection from danger; it covers the human sense without the nautical image.
entries.definitionCN: 指免受危险的地方或状态；可表达庇护义，但不带航海意象。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The two old halves meant 'army' and 'shelter': first a camp, then a port.
normal.cn: 两个古老成分意为「军队」与「庇护」：先是营地，后是港口。

normal.en: The family runs harbor, harbors, harborage, harborer and harborside.
normal.cn: 同族词包括本词、其复数、庇护所、窝藏者与港边形容词。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the senses: a natural harbor, harbor a grudge, harbor doubts, harbor refugees.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各义项：天然良港、心怀怨恨、心存疑虑、收留难民。

normal.en: The verb keeps the image: something is kept safe inside, whether a ship, a hope or a virus.
normal.cn: 动词保留这个意象：某物被安全地保存在里面，无论是船、希望还是病毒。

normal.en: The British spelling adds a u, but the meaning does not change.
normal.cn: 英式拼写多一个字母，但意义不变。

abstract.en: Picture two hands cupped around a small flame to keep the wind off.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手捧住一小簇火苗，替它挡风。

abstract.en: Picture a mind keeping an old anger in a locked drawer.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗心把旧怨锁在抽屉里。

abstract.en: Picture a curved wall of stone holding calm water inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一道弧形石墙把平静的水围在里面。

examples.en: The old harbor now holds fishing boats and a small museum.
examples.cn: 旧港如今停着渔船，还有一座小博物馆。

examples.en: He still harbors a grudge against the former partner.
examples.cn: 他对从前的合伙人仍心怀怨恨。

examples.en: The shelter harbored dozens of families during the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨期间这处避难所收留了几十个家庭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「哈勃」：哈勃把船开进避风的港湾——港口、庇护。

root: 古英语 here「军队」+ beorg「庇护、保护」构成，最初指军队驻扎处；后转为船只与人的庇护处，拼写受法语影响。英语 harbor。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one shelter: a place that keeps something safe. The shelter is first water for ships, then any refuge, a hiding place, the mind holding a feeling, an anchoring action, a port district, a home for people and a container for disease or code.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个庇护展开：让某物安全的地方。这个庇护先是船只的水域，再是任何避难所、藏匿处、保存情感的心、停泊动作、港区、人的收留处与疾病或代码的容器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a curved wall holding calm water, with ships safe inside and rough sea outside.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道弧形墙围住平静的水，船在里面安全，外面是风浪。

branches.en: PORT: the sheltered water and the busy district around it.
branches.cn: 港口：避风水域与其周边繁忙的港区。

branches.en: ANCHORING: the noun becomes the act of bringing a ship into shelter.
branches.cn: 停泊：名词转为把船驶入庇护处的动作。

branches.en: REFUGE: the same shelter protects travellers and displaced families.
branches.cn: 庇护：同一庇护处保护旅人与流离失所的家庭。

branches.en: CONTAINMENT: stolen goods, a virus or a hidden program can all be kept inside.
branches.cn: 容纳：赃物、病毒或隐藏程序都可以被藏在里面。

branches.en: MIND: a feeling is kept safe in the mind's shelter.
branches.cn: 心：情感被安全地保存在心的庇护所里。

intro.en: Harbor is an Old English compound; both halves are native Germanic words, and the final spelling changed later.
intro.cn: 该词是古英语复合词；两半都是本族日耳曼语词，词尾拼写后来改变。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root: the word is Old English, and French only influenced the spelling, so the Latin entry list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁词根：该词是古英语，法语只影响拼写，因此拉丁词条列表留空。

items.example: The first half named the army that needed shelter.
items.exampleCN: 前半部分指需要庇护的军队。

items.example: The second half supplied the protecting place.
items.exampleCN: 后半部分提供保护之处。

items.example: The verb behind the noun meant to keep safe.
items.exampleCN: 名词背后的动词意为使安全。

items.example: The cargo ships entered the harbor at dawn.
items.exampleCN: 货船在黎明时驶入港口。
两座港口为这座岛服务。
这个湾提供了良好的停泊处。

items.example: The harborer of the stolen goods was fined.

definition_zh: 使委屈；使愤愤不平；侵害
definition_en: to cause someone to feel wronged; to infringe upon someone's rights
core_image: 不公平的秤：被压低的那端满脸不平
scene: 评奖结果公布，落选的老员工满腹委屈。 The opaque review process aggrieved many senior staff.
sceneCN: 这里 aggrieve 是「使委屈、使不平」（第 1 个义项：让人感到受了不公正对待）；句意是黑箱的考核流程让许多资深员工愤愤不平。

pos.zh: 使委屈；使愤愤不平；侵害

derivatives.zh: aggrieve 的过去分词形容词化，义为「愤愤不平的；受委屈的」
同根法语分支名词，义为「悲痛」
同根动词，义为「使悲伤；哀悼」
grieve 加名词后缀 -ance，义为「不满；申诉」

senses.title: To make someone feel wronged or resentful
senses.definition: to treat a person so unfairly that resentment follows
senses.definitionCN: 以不公正的方式对待某人，使其心生怨恨
senses.example: The opaque review process aggrieved many senior staff.
senses.exampleCN: 黑箱的考核流程让许多资深员工愤愤不平。
senses.why: The Latin gravis is weight; unfairness loads an invisible weight on a person, and the mind bows under grievance.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 gravis 意为「重」；不公等于往人身上压一副看不见的重担，心情便在委屈下弯了腰。

senses.title: To infringe upon someone's rights
senses.definition: to violate or injure a person's legal rights or interests
senses.definitionCN: 侵犯或损害某人的法定权利与利益
senses.example: The council's ruling aggrieved the property owners' title.
senses.exampleCN: 议会的裁决损害了业主的产权。
senses.why: Law formalised the weight image: whoever loads the burden on another has aggrieved that party in the eyes of the court.
senses.whyCN: 法律把「压重担」的画面制度化：谁把担子压到别人身上，谁就在法庭眼中 aggrieve 了对方。

intro.en: From Old French agrever, from Latin aggravare (to make heavy), with the vowel reshaped by folk link to grief.
intro.cn: 源自古法语 agrever，出自拉丁语 aggravare「使沉重」；因民间联想 grief 而改换了元音拼写。

items.en: The root *gwere- (heavy) is shared by gravis, grave, grief, and aggrieve.
items.cn: 词根 *gwere-（重）为 gravis、grave、grief 与 aggrieve 所共享。

items.en: aggravare meant to weigh down, to make heavier.
items.cn: 拉丁语 aggravare 意为「压重；使更沉重」。

items.en: agrever kept the sense of burdening or wronging someone.
items.cn: 古法语 agrever 保留「使负累、使受屈」之义。

items.en: aggrever named the infringement of rights in petitions and pleas.
items.cn: 盎格鲁-诺曼法律文书中 aggrever 指「侵害权利」。

items.en: aggrieve entered English with both the emotional and the legal senses; aggrieved later became the common adjective.
items.cn: 十三世纪起 aggrieve 进入英语，兼有情绪义与法律义；形容词 aggrieved 后来成为常用形式。

note.en: Aggrieve sits in the heavy family of grief; wronged names the state without naming the burden.
note.cn: aggrieve 属 grief 的「沉重」词族；wronged 只描述状态，不含「重担」意象。

entries.definition: to feel deep sorrow
entries.definitionCN: 悲痛；哀悼——同根，重担化为哀伤

entries.definition: a complaint about unfair treatment
entries.definitionCN: 不满；申诉——aggrieve 的结果名词

entries.definition: feeling wronged
entries.definitionCN: 愤愤不平的——最常用的派生形式

entries.definition: to make worse
entries.definitionCN: 使恶化——拉丁同源孪生词，拼写更接近原形

entries.definition: to treat unjustly
entries.definitionCN: 冤枉；不公对待——最平实的近义动词

entries.definition: to harm, including in law
entries.definitionCN: 伤害；法律上指损害（权利）

entries.definition: to soothe anger
entries.definitionCN: 安抚——aggrieve 的情绪反义

entries.definition: to feel bitter about
entries.definitionCN: 怨恨——描述 aggrieve 造成的心理结果

normalIntro.en: See grieve inside the word: aggrieve is what others do to make you grieve.
normalIntro.cn: 在词里看见 grieve：aggrieve 就是让别人「伤心、憋屈」的行为。

normal.en: ag + grieve: load grief onto someone
normal.cn: ag + grieve：把委屈压到别人身上

normal.en: feel aggrieved is the standard passive-feeling phrase
normal.cn: feel aggrieved 是标准搭配：感到受了委屈

normal.en: an aggrieved party: legal phrase for the wronged side
normal.cn: an aggrieved party 是法律用语：受害一方

normal.en: grievance, grieve, aggrieved: one heavy family
normal.cn: grievance、grieve、aggrieved 同属「沉重」家族

normal.en: aggrieve versus aggravate: wrong a person versus worsen a thing
normal.cn: aggrieve 委屈的是人，aggravate 加重的是事

abstract.en: A scale tipped by hidden stones against one side
abstract.cn: 天平被暗藏的石块压向一侧

abstract.en: A person carrying a rucksack of someone else's mistakes
abstract.cn: 一个人背着装满他人过错的登山包

abstract.en: A door prize handed to everyone except the one who waited longest
abstract.cn: 奖品人人有份，唯独跳过等得最久的那位

examples.en: Tenants felt aggrieved when the rules changed without notice.
examples.cn: 规则说改就改、事先不打招呼，租户们都觉得受了委屈。

examples.en: The appellate court held that the statute aggrieved the plaintiffs' due-process rights.
examples.cn: 上诉法院认定该法规侵害了原告的正当程序权利。

examples.en: He spoke in an aggrieved tone, listing every small slight he remembered.
examples.cn: 他用委屈的语气历数自己记得的每一次冷遇。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额·跪夫」——委屈得额都青了，几乎要向人下跪。谐音仅助记，并非词源。

root: 拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ gravis（重的）构成 aggravare「压重」，经古法语 agrever 进入英语作 aggrieve，拼写受 grief 类推影响；「往人身上压重担」即「使受屈、侵害其权利」。

sensesIntro.en: One burden, two verdicts: the wounded heart and the violated right.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一副重担，两处裁定：受伤的心与被侵犯的权利。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an unfair scale pressing one side down
core.cn: 核心意象：把一端压低的不公平天平

branches.en: injustice felt in the heart
branches.cn: 心中感受到的不公

branches.en: burden laid on someone by another
branches.cn: 由他人压来的重担

branches.en: rights violated in court's eyes
branches.cn: 法庭眼中被侵犯的权利

branches.en: the basis of a formal complaint
branches.cn: 正式申诉的依据

branches.en: the tone of the person wronged
branches.cn: 受屈者特有的语气

intro.en: The word combines ag- (ad-) with the grav root, its spelling softened toward grief.
intro.cn: 该词由前缀 ag-（即 ad-）加 grav 词根构成，拼写向 grief 靠拢。

latinIntro.en: The grav family links heaviness, seriousness, sorrow, and injury.
latinIntro.cn: grav 词族把沉重、严重、悲伤与侵害串成一线。

items.exampleCN: aggrieve、aggravate 中 g 前的 ad- 均写作 ag-
严重身体伤害（法律用语）

latinEntries.example: source of aggrieve and aggravate alike
latinEntries.exampleCN: aggrieve 与 aggravate 的共同来源

derivatives.zh: 愤愤不平的；受屈的（aggrieve 的分词形容词）
极严重的；悲痛的（同根形容词）

definition_zh: 谜；难以理解的人或事物
definition_en: something or someone that is puzzling and hard to explain
core_image: 一封信上写满看不懂的符号，纸角还压着一枚不属于任何国家的邮票
scene: 她从不解释自己为什么每周三消失，办公室的人猜了很久。 Her silence remained an enigma to everyone.
sceneCN: 这里 enigma 指难以理解的人（第 1 个义项：谜一般的人）；句意为她的沉默对所有人始终是个谜。

senses.title: A puzzling person
senses.definition: a person whose motives or history cannot be read
senses.definitionCN: 动机或经历无法被读懂的人
senses.example: Her silence remained an enigma to everyone.
senses.exampleCN: 她的沉默对所有人始终是个谜。
senses.why: People become enigmas when the usual signs, face, tone and habit, stop yielding meaning.
senses.whyCN: 当惯常的符号，表情、语气与习惯，不再给出意义时，人就变成谜。

senses.title: A puzzling event
senses.definition: an occurrence that has no obvious explanation
senses.definitionCN: 没有明显解释的事件
senses.example: The empty boat was an enigma the village never solved.
senses.exampleCN: 那条空船是村子始终没解开的谜。
senses.why: An event becomes an enigma when its cause is missing but its effect is plain.
senses.whyCN: 当原因缺失而结果清楚时，事件就成了谜。

senses.title: A coded message
senses.definition: a text or signal written to be unreadable without a key
senses.definitionCN: 没有密钥便无法读懂的文本或信号
senses.example: The message was an enigma until the key was found.
senses.exampleCN: 在找到密钥之前，这段讯息是个谜。
senses.why: Here the word is technical: the meaning exists, but the route to it is locked.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词是技术性的：意义存在，通往它的路线却被锁住。

senses.title: An unexplained natural thing
senses.definition: a feature of nature whose cause science has not settled
senses.definitionCN: 科学尚未确定成因的自然特征
senses.example: The migration of the birds is still an enigma.
senses.exampleCN: 这些鸟的迁徙仍是一个谜。
senses.why: Nature keeps a store of questions that resist every simple model.
senses.whyCN: 自然保存着一批拒绝任何简单模型的问题。

senses.title: A work hard to interpret
senses.definition: a book, film or painting whose meaning stays open
senses.definitionCN: 意义始终敞着、难以定论的书、影片或画
senses.example: The final chapter is an enigma by design.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一章是刻意留下的谜。
senses.why: Art can use the same lock as a code, but here the missing key is the point.
senses.whyCN: 艺术可以使用与密码相同的锁，但这里缺失的钥匙正是重点。

senses.title: A national puzzle
senses.definition: a public mystery that a whole society discusses
senses.definitionCN: 整个社会都在讨论的公共谜团
senses.example: The vanished ship became a national enigma.
senses.exampleCN: 那艘消失的船成了举国之谜。
senses.why: Scale turns a private puzzle into a shared one, and sharing keeps it alive.
senses.whyCN: 规模把私人的谜变成共同的谜，而共同讨论让它活下来。

senses.title: Enigma as charm
senses.definition: the attractive quality of a person who does not explain everything
senses.definitionCN: 一个不把一切说清的人身上的吸引力
senses.example: He cultivated his enigma as other men cultivate a garden.
senses.exampleCN: 他像别人打理花园那样打理自己的神秘感。
senses.why: Mystery can be a strategy: what is not told keeps other people thinking.
senses.whyCN: 神秘可以是一种策略：没说出的部分让别人一直想着。

senses.title: A riddle of history
senses.definition: an unresolved question about the past that evidence cannot close
senses.definitionCN: 证据无法收束的、关于过去的未解问题
senses.example: Historians still argue over the enigma of the lost colony.
senses.exampleCN: 历史学家仍在争论那个消失殖民地的谜。
senses.why: The past leaves gaps that no amount of evidence can fill, and the gap itself becomes a subject.
senses.whyCN: 过去留下的空白，再多证据也填不满，而空白本身成了主题。

intro.en: Enigma is a Greek word for a riddle, and it shares an origin with the word 'guess'.
intro.cn: enigma 是希腊语中表示谜语的词，它与英语的 guess 出自同一来源。

items.en: Greek ainigma meant 'a dark saying, a riddle', something spoken to be decoded.
items.cn: 希腊语 ainigma 意为「隐语、谜语」，是为被解码而说出的东西。

items.en: Ainissesthai 'to speak darkly' is the verb behind it, from a root for tale or story.
items.cn: ainissesthai「隐晦地说」是其背后的动词，词根与故事有关。

items.en: Latin borrowed the word as aenigma, keeping both the riddle and the darkness.
items.cn: 拉丁语借作 aenigma，把谜语与晦暗都保留下来。

items.en: English took it in the 16c.; by the 17c. it could describe a person as well as a text.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入；到十七世纪它已能形容人，也能形容文本。

items.en: Today it covers ciphers, natural puzzles and anyone whose motives stay closed.
items.cn: 今天它覆盖密码、自然谜题，以及任何动机封闭的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the enigmatic stem; the near-meaning group distinguishes kinds of unexplained things.
note.cn: 形近组共享 enigmatic 词干；近义组区分不同种类的未解之物。

entries.definitionCN: 神秘地；令人费解地

entries.definitionCN: 作为待解谜题提出的问题。

entries.definitionCN: 未知或未解释的事物。

entries.definition: a problem that confuses the mind.
entries.definitionCN: 使头脑困惑的问题。

entries.definition: a secret way of writing or a text in it.
entries.definitionCN: 秘密写法或以此写成的文本。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a letter full of symbols that no one in the room can read.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的联想留住「一封信写满符号、屋里没人读得懂」的画面。

normal.en: Enigma hides a name: the Enigma machine was the coded puzzle of the war.
normal.cn: enigma 藏着一个名字：Enigma 密码机就是那场战争中的谜。

normal.en: Say ih-NIG-muh; the short i sounds like a locked door.
normal.cn: 读成 ih-NIG-muh，短促的 i 像一扇锁住的门。

normal.en: Link with guess: both come from the same old root for telling a tale.
normal.cn: 和 guess 联系：两者都出自同一个表示「讲故事」的古词根。

normal.en: Think of a box with no lid and no visible seam.
normal.cn: 想象一个没有盖子、也看不到接缝的盒子。

normal.en: Enigma ends in -ma, like drama: a mystery is something staged for others to watch.
normal.cn: enigma 以 -ma 结尾，像 drama：谜是被摆出来给人看的戏。

abstract.en: A code and a person can be equally unreadable; the word does not care which.
abstract.cn: 密码和人可以同样难读；这个词不在乎是哪一个。

abstract.en: Mystery is not ignorance; it is knowledge that something is deliberately withheld.
abstract.cn: 神秘不是无知；它是知道有东西被刻意扣住。

abstract.en: What resists explanation longest often attracts the most attention.
abstract.cn: 最久拒绝解释的东西，往往吸引最多注意。

examples.en: Her silence remained an enigma to everyone.
examples.cn: 她的沉默对所有人始终是个谜。

examples.en: The empty boat was an enigma the village never solved.
examples.cn: 那条空船是村子始终没解开的谜。

intro.en: The enigm family keeps the same lock: a noun for the puzzle, an adjective for its manner and an adverb for how it is done.

latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 ainigma 经拉丁语 aenigma 传来；拼写落定为 en-，而晦暗留了下来。
